title: Enablement & Effectiveness Program Manager, Japan and Korea
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE Join us on our mission to help everyone shape the tools that shape their lives. At Notion, we believe in building software that adapts to how people work, not the other way around. As we scale globally, we need someone who can ensure our revenue teams are equipped with the knowledge, tools, and processes to succeed across every geography while maintaining our core values and approach to customer relationships. We're looking for a Revenue Enablement Program Manager to own the development and implementation of global enablement programs that scale seamlessly across regions. You'll spend 50% of your time developing and locally implementing these global programs, and 50% tuning enablement initiatives to meet regional needs—all while maintaining a globally aligned selling process that honors local market nuances. This role sits at the intersection of strategy and execution, requiring someone who can think globally while acting locally. You'll leverage AI and automation to build scalable enablement solutions that empower our revenue teams to deliver exceptional customer experiences worldwide. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE Global Program Development & Implementation (50%) - Champion our global operating cadence to ensure the Japan and Korea region is successfully executing our GTM strategy as an extension of the Global Revenue Operations team - Design, develop and manage comprehensive enablement programs that can be deployed globally while maintaining consistency in our selling methodology and GTM goals - Partner with Revenue Operations, Sales Leadership, and Product Marketing to create scalable training curriculum, design content, program manage SME stakeholders, develop certification programs, deploy continuous training frameworks frameworks and more - Build and maintain our global sales playbook, ensuring it reflects best practices that work across diverse markets - Leverage AI tools and automation to create personalized learning paths, real-time coaching recommendations for revenue team members and leverage the work of our Enablement team - Establish measurement frameworks to track program effectiveness and ROI across all regions — you'll close the loop and report out on progress - Lead cross-functional initiatives to align product releases, go-to-market strategies, and enablement rollouts Regional Tuning & Localization (50%) - Collaborate with regional sales and GTM leaders to identify local market dynamics, competitive landscapes, and customer behavior patterns - Adapt global programs to address regional needs while maintaining core methodology and brand consistency - Create region-specific content, case studies, and competitive battle cards that resonate with local markets - Build feedback loops between regional teams and global program development to continuously improve our approach - Support regional team leads in coaching and reinforcing enablement initiatives within their teams ABOUT YOU Experience & Expertise - 7-10+ years of experience in sales enablement, revenue operations, or similar go-to-market roles - Proven track record of building and scaling enablement programs across multiple geographies - Expert in adult learning methodologies and creating compelling multimodal content - High proficiency with the enablement tool stack including emerging AI and automation solutions (ideally AI is already embedded into your workflow) - Experience working with global sales teams and understanding of diverse market dynamics - Strong analytical skills with experience measuring program impact and ROI Skills & Qualities - Strategic thinker who can balance global consistency with local relevance - Excellent communication and presentation skills, comfortable working with senior leadership - Natural collaborator who thrives in cross-functional environments - Data-driven approach to decision making with strong attention to detail - Adaptable and comfortable with ambiguity in a fast-growing environment - Passionate about developing people and helping teams reach their potential - Fluency in Japanese and English Technical Requirements - Experience with CRM systems (Salesforce preferred), learning management systems, and sales enablement platforms - Proficiency with AI tools for content creation, data analysis, and process automation - Strong project management skills with experience managing multiple initiatives simultaneously - Comfortable with sales analytics and performance metrics NICE TO HAVES - Experience at a high-growth SaaS company - Background in sales, customer success, or revenue-generating roles - International work experience or familiarity with diverse cultural business practices - Experience with Notion or similar productivity tools - Certification in sales methodologies (MEDDIC, Challenger, etc.) - Fluency in Korean #LI-Onsite A NOTE ON AI You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. title: Enterprise Sales Executive, Consumer Products and Services
description: About Toptal Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe , Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce . We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold. Job Summary: As an Enterprise Sales Executive on Toptal’s Consumer Products & Services (CP&S) team, your mission is to win new enterprise clients and secure new business bookings. You will build your own pipeline, open doors into organizations where Toptal does not currently do business, develop opportunities, and close new commercial deals. This is a pure hunter role for accomplished sales professionals who thrive on creating opportunities, competing for business, and turning new relationships into meaningful revenue. You will lead the end-to-end new-client acquisition process, from identifying target accounts and engaging decision-makers to shaping solutions, negotiating commercial terms, and securing the first revenue booking. Working closely with internal subject matter experts and key stakeholders, you will develop compelling solutions, navigate complex buying processes, and close new business. You will partner with Client Partners to ensure a seamless transition following the initial booking, allowing you to remain focused on what you do best: opening new doors and winning new clients. We are looking for exceptional business developers who combine deep Consumer Products & Services industry expertise, executive credibility, and consultative selling skills with the urgency, persistence, and competitive drive of a true hunter. You understand the business and technology challenges facing consumer products, retail, and services organizations, and know how to translate those challenges into compelling commercial opportunities. You leverage your industry knowledge and relationships to navigate complex enterprise sales cycles, engage senior decision-makers, and create demand where none exists. You take ownership of your results, thrive on winning new clients, and do not wait for opportunities to come to you. Consumer products and retail organizations are under pressure to move faster than their current operating models allow. AI has shifted from experimentation to execution, and companies across this sector are actively rethinking how work gets done across brand and marketing, commercial operations, supply chain, and digital commerce. Toptal’s CP&S team already partners with some of the world’s largest consumer products organizations to help address these challenges. You will bring together our capabilities across technology, AI, marketing, management consulting, managed services, and specialized talent to help new clients accelerate strategic initiatives and achieve measurable business outcomes. Success in this role is measured by new enterprise logos acquired and new business booked. This is a high-accountability, high-reward opportunity for individuals who want direct ownership of their commercial results and the opportunity to build a substantial business through their own efforts. This is a remote position with a strong expectation of regular, in-person client engagement and field activity. Candidates based on within commutable distance of a major East Coast metropolitan area are strongly preferred. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English. This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English. Responsibilities: The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills. You will be responsible for building and converting a pipeline of net-new enterprise clients across Consumer Products & Services. You will identify high-potential organizations, develop access to decision-makers, uncover business challenges, and create opportunities for Toptal to compete and win. You will lead the sales process from initial engagement through securing the first revenue booking, working closely with internal subject matter experts and key stakeholders to shape compelling solutions, navigate complex buying processes, and close new business. Your focus is exclusively on acquiring new clients. You will not inherit an existing book of business or carry ongoing account management and expansion responsibilities. Following the initial revenue booking, new clients transition to Client Partners and the appropriate delivery teams. Hunt and win new enterprise clients. Own new-logo acquisition and secured bookings across consumer products, retail, and services organizations, with direct accountability for identifying, developing, and closing new business. Build your own pipeline. Proactively identify target accounts, develop prospecting strategies, leverage your CP&S industry network, and create new opportunities through consistent, disciplined outreach. Partner with SDRs to accelerate prospecting without depending on them to generate your pipeline. Open doors at the executive level. Establish relationships with senior business and technology leaders, economic buyers, and key decision-makers within organizations where Toptal does not have an established commercial relationship. Create demand and shape opportunities. Engage prospective clients around their strategic priorities, identify business problems worth solving, and position Toptal’s capabilities in ways that create compelling reasons to act. Bring informed perspectives on the commercial, operational, and technology challenges shaping the consumer products and retail industries. Lead and close complex sales pursuits. Own the full sales cycle, including qualification, discovery, stakeholder alignment, solution positioning, proposal development, negotiation, procurement, contracting, and securing the initial revenue booking. Compete and win. Develop winning strategies to displace incumbent providers, differentiate Toptal from traditional consulting and technology services firms, and navigate competitive enterprise buying processes. Sell the full breadth of Toptal’s capabilities. Work with internal subject matter experts and key stakeholders to bring together specialized talent, technology, AI, marketing, consulting, and managed services solutions addressing client challenges across digital commerce, supply chain, customer experience, commercial operations, and business transformation. Maintain a high-quality, self-generated pipeline. Build sufficient qualified pipeline to consistently deliver new-logo and bookings targets. Maintain accurate opportunity intelligence, forecasting, and disciplined sales execution. Take ownership of commercial outcomes. Drive opportunities forward with urgency, navigate obstacles, negotiate effectively, and remain personally accountable for securing booked revenue. Execute clean client transitions. Ensure commercial commitments, initial booking details, and relevant client context are transferred to Client Partners and delivery teams, allowing you to return your focus to new-client acquisition. Build a strong market presence. Spend meaningful time in front of prospective clients, developing relationships through executive networking, CP&S industry events, referrals, and direct engagement. We are seeking people who enjoy the hunt as much as the win. You should be energized by breaking into new accounts, creating opportunities from scratch, and securing business that would not exist without your efforts. In the first week, expect to: Onboard with Toptal, learning our business model, value proposition, and capabilities. Familiarize yourself with our sales methodologies, prospecting tools, and commercial processes. Understand our CP&S industry strategy, target client profiles, priority segments, and markets. Meet the Industry, Sales Development, and internal subject matter experts and stakeholders who will support your success. Become familiar with our contracting, legal, and commercial processes. In the first month, expect to: Develop a targeted new-logo acquisition plan with your CP&S Industry GM, identifying priority accounts, executive buyers, and initial pursuit strategies. Begin actively prospecting into new consumer products, retail, and services accounts, leveraging your existing industry relationships while building new ones. We are headquartered in San Francisco, California with operations in Canada and the UK, and a tech-hub in Poland. We are a Deep Learning first company. Our mission is to automate and optimize brick and mortar retail using deep learning computer vision. Focal Systems has been deployed at scale with some of the top retailers in the world.</p> <p>We seek smart, creative and passionate people who want to help build a great and enduring company and deploy Deep Learning to the world!</p> <h2><strong>About the Role</strong></h2> <p>As Director of Operations, UK you will help build and lead the field operations team that installs and maintains Focal Systems shelf cameras across our UK retail partners. Our cameras are being deployed at scale, with 100,000+ units live or rolling out at leading retailers around the world, and the UK is a major part of that growth.</p> <p>You will support the running of UK operations end to end: the people, the processes, the metrics, and the customer outcomes. You will work closely with senior and executive leadership to set and roll out operational strategy, and with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to make every deployment faster, more reliable, and more cost-effective than the last.</p> <p>You will be joining an established, experienced team that works in cycles. Retailer rollouts bring periods of rapid scale-up, followed by quieter maintenance periods where we scale back down, and those transitions have not always been smooth. A key part of this role is making them smoother: planning ahead for each change in pace, keeping the team steady and supported through it, and building processes that let us ramp up and down without losing quality or momentum.</p> <p>This is a senior leadership role. You will develop our existing team, support during scale-up and scale-down periods, set the operating rhythm for field work, and be the person our customers and colleagues rely on when something needs to get done.</p> <h2><strong>What We Are Looking For</strong></h2> <ul> <li>You are a hands-on operations leader who has scaled field teams and processes, and you are as comfortable working with stakeholders at different levels</li> <li>You run operations on data: you define the right metrics, watch them closely, and act early when they move</li> <li>You build structure where there is none, designing roles, workflows, and SOPs that hold up as volume grows and priorities shift</li> <li>You hire well, coach well, and build teams that take ownership without needing to be chased</li> <li>You understand that operations is a customer-facing function, and you take pride in exceeding what our retail partners expect</li> <li>You thrive in a fast-moving, remote-first environment and are energised by building something new</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What You Will Be Doing</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Own ongoing field-service performance and SLA delivery, prioritising maintenance work and driving issues through to resolution.</li> <li>Build, lead, and develop a high-performing UK field operations team responsible for installing and maintaining shelf cameras at scale</li> <li>Own the operational plan for UK deployments, from scheduling and logistics through installation, quality checks, and ongoing maintenance</li> <li>Define, track, and report on the key metrics for field performance and SLA adherence</li> <li>Partner with executive leadership to set performance goals, budgets, and long-term operational strategy for the UK</li> <li>Analyse operational processes end to end, identify bottlenecks, and lead improvements that increase speed, quality, and efficiency</li> <li>Work across Product, Engineering, Supply Chain, and Customer Success to feed field insights back into hardware, software, and deployment playbooks</li> <li>Act as the senior escalation point for operational and customer issues, removing blockers quickly and owning the outcome</li> <li>Build strong relationships with retail partners, understand their store operations, agree success criteria, and deliver against them</li> <li>Manage relationships with any third-party installers or service partners, including performance, quality, and cost</li> <li>Establish safe working practices and ensure field activity meets health and safety requirements at every retailer site</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Requirements</strong></h2> <ul> <li>5+ years in an operations leadership role, with a track record of managing people, processes, and budgets</li> <li>Experience leading field operations, installation, or service teams across multiple sites, ideally deploying hardware at scale</li> <li>Strong working knowledge of core operational functions, including finance and budgeting, customer service, logistics, and people management</li> <li>Proven ability to plan and run operations for efficiency and productivity, using data and KPIs to drive decisions</li> <li>Experience designing and implementing new structures, roles, and processes that support rapid growth and shifting business needs</li> <li>Solid understanding of account management and customer success, and comfort working directly with senior customer stakeholders</li> <li>Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to present clearly to executives, customers, and field teams</li> <li>Ability to work independently in a remote environment and travel regularly within the UK</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Nice to Have</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Knowledge of retail or grocery operations</li> <li>Familiarity with retail technology such as shopper-facing apps, back-room inventory management, or POS systems</li> <li>Experience managing third-party installers, contractors, or service partners</li> <li>Lean Six Sigma or a similar process improvement certification</li> <li>Experience in a high-growth startup or scale-up environment</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Why Focal Systems</strong></p> <p>Strong Values and Mission - We are a tightly-knit team with an ambitious mission and a strong set of core values, which define our approach to business and have successfully guided us since inception.</p> <p>Exceptional Team - We are a team of hard-working, fun-loving professionals from some of the most eminent universities, research labs, and tech companies of our time. We pride ourselves on recruiting exceptional individuals to help us redefine the state-of-the-art.</p> <p>Outstanding Partners - We work with 10+ of the largest retailers in the world and have a world-class roster of investors, advisors and partners to support & advise us in our endeavors.<br><br></p> <p><strong>What we offer</strong><strong><br></strong>We care deeply about the health, happiness, and wellbeing of all of our employees. We offer:    </p> <ul> <li>Competitive Salary & Attractive Stock</li> <li>Generous Paid Time Off </li> <li>Pension</li> <li>Sick Leave</li> <li>Parental Leave</li> <li>Learning and Development Budget</li> </ul> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Staff Product Manager: Product Discovery Engine
description: Staff Product Manager, Product Discovery Engine About Us Constructor powers product search and discovery for some of the largest retailers in the world. We serve billions of requests every week, and you’ve probably seen our results somewhere and used our product without knowing it. We differentiate ourselves by focusing on metrics over features, and reinventing search and discovery from the ground up as a machine learning challenge with the specific goal of improving metrics like revenue. We’re approximately doubling year over year despite the market slowing down and have customers in every eCommerce vertical. We’re a passionate team of technologists who love solving problems and want to make our customers’ and coworkers’ lives better. We value empathy, openness, curiosity, continuous improvement, and are excited by metrics that matter. We believe that empowering everyone in a company to do what they think is best can lead to great things. Job Summary We’re looking for a systems-minded Staff Product Manager to take Constructor’s search and discovery to the state of the art — and keep it there — across every retail industry we serve. This is a highly technical, high-leverage role at the core of our Product Discovery Engine chapter: the teams responsible for how we retrieve, understand, and rank the right products for every shopper, on every query, for every customer. Your job is to raise discovery quality and, through it, our customers’ business metrics. You won’t be measured on features shipped — you’ll be measured on relevance and business outcomes, like conversion, revenue per visit, and search-attributed GMV, moving up. You’ll start embedded with our Search Quality team, owning its strategy and roadmap and getting deep into the systems that decide what shoppers actually see. Over time, your mandate grows to setting direction for the entire Product Discovery Engine chapter — deciding where we’re heading and why across recall, ranking, query understanding, personalization, and the ML infrastructure underneath. This is a Staff role today with a clear path to Director as you take on chapter-wide leadership. Search at Constructor is fundamentally a machine learning problem, so this role lives and breathes ML. You’ll partner closely with ML, data science, and engineering to turn the latest research into production wins, keep us ahead of both commercial competitors and academic state of the art, and be the connective tissue that aligns multiple teams — ML Recall, ML Infra, and, over time, teams like CORE, SABR, and Catalog Management — behind a single, coherent vision for great discovery. If you’re excited about driving innovation across dozens of the world’s largest retailers, being held to relevance and business outcomes, and pushing an already best-in-class product further ahead, this role is for you. What You’ll Do Own business impact, not features. Drive measurable lift in search-attributed conversion, revenue per visit, and GMV alongside relevance across our customer base. Deliver across every retail industry. Move quality and business metrics across all the verticals we serve, accounting for the differences in catalog, language, and shopper intent. Keep us at the state of the art. Continuously translate the latest ML / IR research and competitive moves into production wins, and ship SOTA ML / LLM-assisted capabilities that beat our previous best on relevance. Set chapter vision and strategy. Define the multi-quarter direction for the Product Discovery Engine — where we’re heading and why — tie it directly to customer business outcomes, and rally teams behind it. Lead Search Quality first. Own its strategy and roadmap, driving measurable improvements in the relevance and correctness of results. Orchestrate across the pipeline. Unify recall, ranking, query understanding, and personalization behind one definition of quality and one set of business metrics, so improvements compound instead of colliding. Turn ML research into production wins. Partner deeply with ML and data science to take models — from candidate generation and recall to LLM-assisted interpretation — from idea to production, balancing accuracy, latency, and cost. Make quality measurable and explainable. Build the metrics, evaluation frameworks, and tooling the whole chapter uses to measure, attribute, and explain discovery quality and its business impact. Own quality under pressure. Lead investigation and triage when issues arise, and design durable, systemic fixes rather than one-off patches. Grow the mandate. Expand into chapter-wide leadership spanning ML Recall, ML Infra, and — over time — teams like CORE, SABR, and Catalog Management. What Success Looks Like Within your first year, you will have: Driven measurable lift in search-attributed conversion and revenue per visit — moving business metrics, not just quality metrics. Driven measurable business-metric lift (conversion, revenue per visit, GMV) and relevance lift across every major retail vertical we serve . Shipped at least one state-of-the-art ML / LLM-assisted capability into production that beats our previous best on relevance. Won head-to-head quality benchmarks against every major competitor in the verticals we compete in, with a repeatable, defensible methodology. Taken core quality metrics to best-in-class levels and kept them improving quarter over quarter. Stood up an evaluation framework and tooling that ties model and system investments directly to customer business outcomes . What We’re Looking For Extensive product management experience (typically 8+ years) in search, discovery, ML, or NLP-heavy products, including time operating at a senior or staff level. A track record of moving business metrics at scale — conversion, revenue, engagement — not just shipping features, and of setting strategy across multiple teams. Deep understanding of the end-to-end search pipeline: query interpretation → recall / candidate generation → ranking → reranking → personalization → delivery. Strong ML product depth — owning production models and reasoning about tradeoffs between high-capacity (LLM / batch) and low-latency (real-time) approaches — and a habit of staying current with state-of-the-art research. Fluency with retrieval and recall, query understanding (tokenization, synonyms, spelling correction, multilingual support), and search evaluation frameworks. A rigorous, measurement-first mindset that ties every quality investment back to business outcomes. Excellent cross-functional leadership — able to align teams with different goals behind a shared definition of quality and a shared set of business metrics, working shoulder-to-shoulder with engineering, data science, and ML Ops. Comfort operating with ambiguity, setting direction where none exists yet, and leading through clarity and credibility rather than the org chart. Benefits Unlimited vacation time — we strongly encourage all of our employees to take at least 3 weeks per year. A competitive compensation package including stock options. Company-sponsored US health coverage (100% paid for employee). Fully remote team — choose where you live. Work-from-home stipend! We want you to have the resources you need to set up your home office. Apple laptops provided for new employees. Training and development budget for every employee, refreshed each year. Parental leave for qualified employees. Work with smart people who will help you grow and make a meaningful impact. This position is fully remote — Constructor.io is a remote-first company. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome individuals of all backgrounds and provide equal opportunities to all applicants regardless of their education, diversity of opinion, race, color, religion, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status or affiliation in any other protected group. If you are not selected, we will retain your data for a limited period as described in our Recruitment Privacy Notice . After that period your data will be deleted or anonymized. title: Software Engineer - Storage
description: ABOUT SUPABASE Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth. ABOUT THE ROLE Supabase Storage https://supabase.com/docs/guides/storage is a scalable and high performance object storage service and is one of our fastest growing services. The current landscape of tools for uploading, storing, processing and delivering assets is complicated. Developers are forced to think about regions, caching, codecs and security before they can start uploading anything. We are looking for engineers to solve this problem once and for all! You will be working across the entire stack - client libraries, CLI, CDN, the storage server and the deployment infrastructure. One day, you might focus on improving upload resilience in iOS applications; the next, you could be optimizing the S3 protocol for efficient retries or finding ways to accelerate upload processing. You will be contributing to both our open source server https://github.com/supabase/storage and upstream dependencies we use, like the TUS server https://github.com/tus/tus-node-server/pulls?q=sort%3Aupdated-desc+is%3Apr+author%3Afenos+is%3Amerged. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in async, fast-paced environments and is excited about building developer tools that scale to millions. WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR - Improving our analytics bucket offering and improving the storage of open file formats like iceberg and ducklake - Asset optimization to speed up delivery for websites and mobile applications - Building out our edge network to speed up uploads and build features like automatic cache invalidation - Improve the performance, observability, and reliability of our storage server - Work with the frontend team to build a fast, powerful storage explorer - Improve our APIs, client libraries and CLI to provide an exceptional end-to-end DX for our users - Resolve escalated support issues, while also identifying and resolving systemic issues across the platform YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU - Have 5+ years backend engineering experience of running Node.js in production - Have experience with highly scalable, distributed systems - Are comfortable with working across the stack - backend application development, some infrastructure work including deploying, monitoring and scaling the service - Posses familiarity with observability tools (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana) and performance tuning - Have experience with production-grade PostgreSQL usage, including tuning and troubleshooting - Demonstrate an ownership mentality: driving projects end-to-end - Display empathy towards developer experience NICE-TO-HAVE - Prior experience working on developer tools - Solid knowledge of cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP or Azure) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) - Direct experience designing and operating large file upload/download pipelines at scale - Deep, practical CDN integration and optimization knowledge - Experience with image and video processing tools (sharp, dssim, ffmpeg), formats and codecs (AVIF, WebM, Brotli) is a plus - Experience with the frontend ecosystem (Next.js, React, etc) is a plus WHAT WE OFFER - Fully Remote We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world. - ESOP Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together. - Tech Allowance Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work. - Health Benefits Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. title: Intermediate Fullstack Engineer (Ruby/Vue.js), Growth
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2>An overview of this role</h2> <p>As an Intermediate Fullstack Engineer (Ruby/Vue.js), Growth at GitLab, you'll help turn GitLab's self-serve funnel into a reliable source of new paying customers. You'll work on the in-product journey from a user's first visit through sign-up, trial, and first purchase, on both GitLab.com and self-managed GitLab. You'll collaborate closely with Product Managers, UX Designers, and Data Analysts, with a particular focus on backend development in Ruby on Rails and frontend work in Vue.js. This role gives you the opportunity to combine your fullstack engineering skills with product thinking and experimentation, shipping small changes quickly and measuring their impact on real customer outcomes.</p> <p><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/engineering/development/growth/">Some examples of our projects:</a></p> <ul> <li value="1">Making it easier for self-managed users to try and buy GitLab</li> <li value="2">Building upgrade prompts where users run into paid features</li> <li value="3">Improving the trial experience, including trials of GitLab Duo</li> <li value="4">Improving the tooling the team uses to run and read out experiments</li> </ul> <h2>What you'll do</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Design, build, and iterate on A/B tests and experiments that increase first purchases on GitLab.com and self-managed GitLab.</li> <li value="2">Build and improve registration, trial, onboarding, and in-product upgrade and purchase experiences to increase completion of these steps.</li> <li value="3">Implement backend features and services in Ruby on Rails and frontend experiences using Vue.js.</li> <li value="4">Analyze experiment results and product usage data with Data Analysts to decide which changes to keep, iterate on, or roll back based on first-purchase outcomes.</li> <li value="5">Collaborate with Product Managers and UX Designers to define hypotheses and success metrics before shipping experiments, then compare results against those metrics.</li> <li value="6">Maintain and improve our experimentation framework and tooling to increase experiment throughput and reduce the time from setup to results.</li> <li value="7">Collaborate with other Engineering teams, including Fulfillment, to remove purchase barriers across GitLab’s codebase.</li> <li value="8">Document decisions, review code, and share experiment results asynchronously so distributed teammates can track shipped changes and their measured outcomes.</li> </ul> <h2>What you'll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Professional experience developing with Ruby on Rails and modern JavaScript, along with solid Git, feature development, and deployment workflows.</li> <li value="2">Experience working with relational databases and a solid understanding of web performance optimization.</li> <li value="3">A track record of shipping features to production and owning them after release.</li> <li value="4">Ability to use product data to decide what to build, keep, or roll back.</li> <li value="5">Ability to document decisions and share updates asynchronously with distributed Product Management, UX, and Data teammates.</li> <li value="6">Ability to organize your work, seek and apply feedback, and collaborate inclusively with teammates from diverse backgrounds, in line with GitLab’s values.</li> <li value="7">Preferred, not required: experience with Vue.js, PostgreSQL, A/B testing, feature flags, experimentation frameworks, or SaaS sign-up, trial, billing, or checkout flows. We'll help you learn our tooling.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>We’re GitLab’s Growth team: one team with one roadmap, prioritizing work by how directly it helps people buy. We work fully remotely and asynchronously across multiple regions, guided by GitLab’s values of transparency and iteration. Our challenge is running more high-impact experiments, faster, while coordinating changes with teams like Fulfillment and Pricing across the parts of the product they own. For more on how we work, see the <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/engineering/development/growth/">Growth</a> and <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/product/">Product</a> sections of the GitLab handbook.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  </p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#equal-employment-opportunity-policy" target="_blank">GitLab’s EEO Policy</a> and <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/labor-and-employment-notices/#eeoc-us-equal-employment-opportunity-commission-notices" target="_blank">EEO is the Law</a>. If you have a disability or special need that requires <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#reasonable-accommodation" target="_blank">accommodation</a>, please let us know during the <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/interviewing/#adjustments-to-our-interview-process" target="_blank">recruiting process</a>.</p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: UP42 was founded in 2019 with a clear purpose: to transform how organizations order, access, and analyze Earth observation data. Our platform brings together the world's leading geospatial providers, and offers a single touchpoint to access, manage, and process data at scale. From vegetation management and infrastructure monitoring to disaster response, UP42 helps organizations across industries find solutions to complex problems through Earth observation. Our expert support team and detailed documentation guide our users through every step. Since July 2025, UP42 has been a part of Neo Space Group. We are looking for a Senior Sales Manager & Team Lead, EMEA (m/f/x) to join our Sales team in Berlin (hybrid) or remotely in Germany. Our EMEA team is growing into large European enterprises, and our enterprise go-to-market is still maturing. In this role you sell to those enterprises yourself, and you coach our Sales Managers in the region. Most of your results will come from your own sales, and you will work closely with Marketing and Customer Success teams. What you will do: Drive strategic pipeline and account growth with large European enterprises in energy, finance, insurance and infrastructure. Win and grow strategic enterprise opportunities with our Earth Observation platform. Build relationships with some of Europe's largest enterprise accounts. Deliver your annual sales targets with a healthy and repeatable enterprise pipeline. Coach and mentor your team members, and help them capture and manage complex enterprise opportunities. Improve deal quality, deal progression and forecasting across the EMEA team. Strengthen enterprise selling discipline as our enterprise go-to-market matures. Here is a good summary of what we are looking for: Significant years of sales experience within the geospatial industry, including Earth observation, remote sensing, GIS platform sales, satellite imagery, LiDAR, or adjacent technologies Proven success selling data and/or platforms into enterprise customers, including managing long sales cycles and complex buying committees Enterprise sales experience in the European market Strong track record of sourcing, structuring, and closing high-value deals while carrying and consistently achieving quota Willingness to act as player-coach and to mentor others Ability to guide and develop experienced sellers Track record of planning pipeline and delivering deals in line with forecast Knowledge of remote sensing and geospatial markets in Europe, with vertical expertise in energy, finance, insurance or infrastructure Bonus points if you bring: Team management experience Let us tell you why UP42 is a good choice: Let's disrupt the industry: You get the chance to shape the state-of-the-art geospatial processing platform and create a completely new planetary perspective. Let's stay flexible: We practice a hybrid working model - you can choose when to work from the comfort of your home or join your colleagues in our modern office in the heart of Kreuzberg, or even from a global place of your choice up to 90 days per year. Let's win as a team: We're an inspiring international team working in a fun and productive environment. Let's be fair: We offer a competitive salary package and other perks such as wellbeing initiatives, sponsored fitness subscriptions, educational budget for your personal development and public transportation discount - just to name a few. Let's enjoy the good side of life: Gather in regular team events as well as our global company parties twice a year. Let's think outside of the box: There are challenges and enough space for creativity and taking ownership. Does this sound like a good next step into your geospatial career? title: Disputes & Chargebacks Manager
description: At Vio we believe booking accommodation should feel smart, fair, and effortless — never overwhelming or unclear. As one of the world’s fastest-growing travel tech platforms, we help millions of users make smarter travel decisions by comparing stays across 100+ booking sites — so they can find the perfect place, at the best price, anywhere in the world. We cut through the noise and complexity of hotel and vacation rental booking, surfacing real value with clarity, transparency, and full support. No tricks. No confusion. Just great stays — booked with confidence. With operations in 100+ markets and growing fast, our mission is to reshape how people discover and book accommodation through technology travelers can trust. We’re looking for an experienced Disputes & Chargebacks Manager to own and continuously improve our disputes function end to end. You’ll be accountable for two closely connected areas: dispute management and chargeback representment . On dispute management, you’ll own how we identify and respond to dispute trends, improve prevention, strengthen evidence, and coordinate effectively with internal teams and external partners. On chargeback representment, you’ll own the operational health and performance of the process including case quality, deadlines, win rates, team effectiveness, partner performance and automation. The role requires operational ownership with the goal of improving dispute outcomes while scaling the function efficiently as volumes grow. ☑️ What you’ll do Run the dispute operation day to day, making sure cases are handled accurately and on time Manage volume, workload and escalations across the team and our outsourced partners, holding partners to clear targets on quality, speed and cost Review representments and evidence, coach the team, and set the quality bar Decide when to fight, accept or escalate a dispute based on evidence, value and effort Analyse won and lost cases to sharpen strategy, and flag unusual dispute or fraud trends quickly Work with Customer Support, Product, Finance, Payments and Fraud to reduce avoidable disputes through changes to fraud rules, refund policies, communication and the product Redesign workflows around automation, including triage, evidence gathering, deadline tracking and AI-assisted drafting with human review Partner with Data and Engineering to build reliable reporting on dispute performance 🔎 Who you are You have 5+ years of hands-on experience in disputes and chargebacks, including writing representments yourself You know dispute lifecycles, reason codes, evidence requirements and representment strategy in depth You have led a disputes and chargebacks function, including team performance and operational delivery You find trends, risks and opportunities in data, and turn them into concrete process changes You have set quality standards and coached people to meet them Nice to have: experience in travel, hospitality or marketplaces where the company is the merchant of record; managing outsourced dispute teams; scaling a manual operation with tooling, AI or automation; and working with card scheme monitoring programmes and chargeback-ratio thresholds In your first months, you’ll work live cases yourself, set a trusted baseline for performance, and launch the first automation initiative. By month six, we expect measurable improvement in win rates, quality and cost, and a working loop with other teams that prevents avoidable disputes Why join us now? We are one of the most innovative and fastest-growing accommodation booking platforms in the world today, having grown our bookings 30x between 2017 and 2025, and catering to the needs of over 100 million unique visitors worldwide each year. We do that by harnessing the power of advanced algorithms and an innovative suite of power features and managed to overcome the corona crisis remarkably fast ; The mobile applications ( iOS and Android ) we launched in 2023 are already a big success, reaching 5 million installs with great customer reviews, as we are beginning to build Vio as the brand for value-seeking travellers worldwide; We are a passionate and diverse team of tech enthusiasts and creatives with a commitment and focus on the traveler above all else - and it shows in our industry-leading TrustPilot score ; We place huge importance on rewarding our employees for the value they generate by giving Stock Appreciation Rights to all employees. Do you want to know if Vio is the right place for you? Find out by reading about the attitude that thrives at Vio. What we offer: Plenty of chances to learn and grow within an open, diverse culture which promotes knowledge sharing, trust and transparency; A great compensation package, perks and benefits (including significant stock appreciation rights); Flexible time off (take as many holidays as you need) and a chance to work remotely; You will be part of a highly international team that enjoys working, eating and playing together in one of the best office locations in Amsterdam; We value good food and offer catered lunches from various cuisines, great coffee, and the occasional barbecue in our garden; We enjoy getting together to celebrate our wins with company events in Amsterdam and abroad; A budget for your dream home office; Access to free mental health support via OpenUp . title: GTM Enablement - Global Onboarding & Operations
description: About ElevenLabs ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. How we work High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. What we offer Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy. Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. About the role As the Global Onboarding & Enablement Operations Program Manager at ElevenLabs, you’ll help keep our global GTM onboarding and enablement programmes running smoothly as we grow. You’ll lead the day-to-day delivery of onboarding, making sure every new GTM hire gets a consistent, engaging start, while building the structure and processes that help the wider Enablement team work more effectively and scale its impact. You’ll bring structure to how we plan, deliver and measure enablement, from tracking OKRs and roadmaps to coordinating the enablement calendar, launches and certifications. You’ll also help keep the team aligned on priorities, manage cross-functional dependencies and use reporting to understand what’s working and where we can improve. Working closely with the Sales Enablement lead and partners across GTM, RevOps, Product Marketing and People, you’ll help turn priorities into well-run programmes that meet the needs of the business. This role is a great fit for someone who enjoys bringing order to complex projects, delivering engaging training and finding practical, creative ways to solve problems. Own GTM onboarding: Manage onboarding cohorts end to end, from scheduling and communications to facilitating live sessions, coordinating speakers and gathering feedback. Ensure new hires across regions have a consistent, engaging experience. Develop and maintain learning content: Create training materials and e-learning modules, and keep existing content across WorkRamp and Enablement OS accurate, relevant and easy to navigate. Work with subject matter experts to turn complex topics into practical learning experiences. description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2>An overview of this role</h2> <p>As an Ecosystem Operations Specialist, you'll help turn GitLab's Ecosystem go-to-market strategy into reliable day-to-day execution. Identify and route exceptions requiring commercial, policy, contractual, pricing, payment, or systems decisions to the appropriate owner.</li> <li value="4">Execute and improve partner program workflows, including onboarding, not-for-resale licensing, certifications, rebates, Professional Services Partner eligibility, Letters of Authorization, and channel price files. Collaborate with Programs and policy owners on required notifications, documentation, and compliance reporting.</li> <li value="5">Monitor Salesforce and partner-management data for missing links, incorrect ownership, incomplete attribution, failed synchronization, and recurring defects. Support month-end close, recurring data controls, and ad hoc reporting tied to projects and company objectives and key results.</li> <li value="6">Build and present dashboards and business updates on backlog, aging, turnaround time, approvals, pipeline, attribution, data quality, compliance, and process health. Share trends, risks, blockers, and recommended actions in regional and global partner team meetings.</li> <li value="7">Investigate recurring friction and manual work, document root causes and operational requirements, test process or system changes, and support automation and scalable self-service improvements.</li> <li value="8">Maintain process documentation, how-to guides, and best practices, and deliver office hours, operational training, and communications when processes or systems change.</li> </ul> <h2>What you'll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Relevant experience in partner operations, sales operations, deal desk, order management, finance operations, or a similar revenue operations environment, including direct support for sales or partner sales teams, distributors, and partners, along with an interest in GitLab and open source software.</li> <li value="2">Experience with enterprise quote-to-cash processes and configure, price, quote tools or other commercial systems in a channel or partner context.</li> <li value="3">Experience with Salesforce and partner-management systems or portals.</li> <li value="4">Strong analytical skills, including advanced spreadsheets, dashboard building in Salesforce or business intelligence tools such as Tableau, and turning data into clear recommendations.</li> <li value="5">Hands-on experience using generative artificial intelligence (AI) tools to improve operational productivity, quality, or scale, including writing effective prompts, judging when outputs need human review, and sharing useful approaches with others.</li> <li value="6">Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to prioritize requests, investigate issues, identify exceptions, and escalate decisions to the appropriate owner, along with experience contributing to process improvement and automation.</li> <li value="7">Clear written and verbal communication, including explaining operational requirements to technical and non-technical audiences, documenting processes, creating enablement materials, and collaborating across Sales, Ecosystem, Programs, Deal Desk, Finance, Legal, Billing, and Systems.</li> <li value="8">Preferred experience includes Impartner or similar tools, SQL, or Snowflake.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>The Ecosystem team supports GitLab's partner go-to-market strategy. Unser Schwerpunkt ist das Microsoft-Umfeld: Microsoft 365, Copilot, Copilot Studio und Power Automate. Wir sind ein kleines Team, arbeiten direkt mit der Geschäftsführung und entscheiden schnell. title: Technical Account Manager - German Speaking
description: Artificial Intelligence. Actual Impact. At Docebo, we’re using AI to change how people learn at work—and we mean actually change it. We’re an AI-powered learning platform that helps organizations create, deliver, and manage training all in one place. But our real mission goes deeper: we help teams move faster, work smarter, and focus on the work that truly matters. Our platform is built with intelligent, time-saving tools that personalize learning, eliminate busywork, and turn training from a checkbox into a superpower. The result? Better experiences for learners and real results for businesses. We’re shaping the future of learning with a team that isn’t afraid to challenge the status quo. If you're excited by the idea of using AI to make work-life better for real people–you’ll feel right at home here. And it’s not just what we build, it’s how we show up. At Docebo, our values aren’t just posters on the wall—they guide how we work every day. We call it the Docebo Heart : trust by default, assume positive intent, and create space for different perspectives to thrive. So… what are you waiting for? Join 900+ Docebians around the world and help us reinvent the way people learn, because learning never stops. 🚀 The Adventure Ahead As a Technical Account Manager, you’re the trusted technical engine behind our enterprise customers' greatest learning transformations! You will embed yourself as an essential strategic partner, bridging high-level customer business goals with Docebo’s cutting-edge platform capabilities. In this role, you won't just solve problems—you'll architect long-term technical strategies, pilot innovative solutions, and ensure our customers unlock maximum value to become partners for life. This is a fully remote position, open to candidates located in Germany. ⚡ The Day-to-Day Architect the Future: Translate customer business and eLearning goals into long-term, scalable technical strategies using Docebo’s robust feature set. Own the Technical Relationship: Take full technical and product ownership of your assigned enterprise accounts while collaborating closely with Account Teams on commercial growth. Serve as the Trusted Advisor: Guide executive and technical stakeholders through platform innovations, API integrations, and AI-assisted workflows to maximize operational efficiency. Proactively Protect Platform Health: Monitor technical performance metrics—like API usage and login trends—to catch and mitigate potential risks long before they hit platform stability. Lead Executive Technical Reviews: Deliver high-impact performance presentations on SLAs directly to customer leadership and champion customer feedback internally to Docebo teams. Drive Systemic Platform Improvements: Partner with Premium Advisors and internal resources to analyze support case patterns, run proof-of-concept pilot projects, and streamline overall platform health. 💪 Your Superpowers Enterprise SaaS Expertise: Bring 5+ years of SaaS technical troubleshooting and 2+ years of enterprise/large account management experience. Integration & Auth Mastery: Hold a solid foundation in back-end practices, RESTful APIs, OAuth 2.0, SAML, and front-end essentials like JavaScript, CSS, and HTML. Data & Middleware Savvy: Possess hands-on skills in at least two key areas: iPaaS tools (e.g., Workato, Zapier), SQL queries, or data warehousing/BI tools (e.g., Snowflake, Tableau, Power BI). Executive Translator: Master the art of taking complex, highly technical concepts and translating them into simple, high-value business conversations for executive decision-makers. Global Flexibility & Travel: Ready to support EMEA regional time zones and comfortable traveling internationally up to 25% of the time. Project Management Mindset: Bring proactive ownership, analytical decision-making, and experience forecasting product release impacts or advising on AI/automation integrations. German language proficiency is required; however, English is the primary language used for day-to-day communication and collaboration. 🌟 Bonus Points Cloud Certified: Possess an active AWS Product Certification. Domain Experience: Background in the e-Learning, Learning Management (LMS), or Human Capital Management (HCM) industries. Scalability Specialist: Direct experience consulting on platform performance, high availability, uptime, and enterprise scalability. Our Hybrid Work Philosophy 🤝 Great work can happen anywhere but coming together helps us go further. Our team spends three days a week in the office (Tuesday-Thursday) to collaborate, solve problems, and learn from each other. With flexibility the rest of the week, it’s a balance designed to help everyone do their best work and keep growing. Our Total Rewards Philosophy 🎉 Our Total Rewards Philosophy centers around three core areas to reward and care for our People: Rewarding Impact: We lead with competitive pay to reward the impact, skills and traits that fuel our success. Fostering Holistic Wellbeing: We care deeply about and invest in the whole person with programs that support our people’s physical, mental, and financial well-being. Empowering Our Talent Culture: We build a culture of trust and empowerment by designing our rewards and benefits with transparency, equity, and flexibility, enabling our people to do their best work and stay for the long haul. Our Promise to You 😍 Financial Wellness: Own a piece of Docebo through our Employee Share Purchase Plan (ESPP) at a 15% discount, plus a competitive compensation package. Your Well-Being, Covered: You’ll get access to health benefits, so you can get the care you need when you need it. Rest, Relax, Repeat: Rest and recharge with paid vacation days, two company-wide Docebo Days, floating holidays for cultural celebrations, and your birthday off! Family First : We provide coverage offering you time with your little one(s) so you can soak up all those precious moments. Fun fact: we had 30 Docebian babies join the family in 2025! Connections That Count: Connect with global communities through our Employee Resource Groups (including PRIDE, DWA, BIDOC, and Green Ambassadors) and company-wide events that keep the fun rolling all year long. About Docebo 💙 At Docebo, we create seamless, AI-powered learning experiences for over 3,000 customers worldwide. We have successfully achieved two IPOs ( TSX: DCBO & NASDAQ: DCBO ), been recognized as a top SaaS e-learning solution, and are growing exponentially in the process. We're a global company, with office across North America, EMEA, APAC, and beyond. Our team is guided by five core values— Grow Together Win Together, Build with Our Customer, Clear is Kind, Own Outcomes, Progress Over Perfection —that shape everything we do. If this resonates with you, now is the perfect time to join one of the fastest-growing learning technology companies in the world. Docebo is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer . We are committed to diversity and inclusion in our workforce. All qualified applicants and employees will receive consideration for employment regardless of their race, colour, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, citizenship status, age, disability, genetic information, or any other category protected under applicable law. As a federal contractor, Docebo is committed to the principles of affirmative action and equal employment opportunity for protected veterans and individuals with disabilities. Docebo does not discriminate because of protected veteran status or on the basis of disability, and Docebo takes affirmative action to employ and advance in employment qualified protected veterans and individuals with disabilities. Any individuals requiring a reasonable accommodation or would like to voluntarily disclose a disability or protected veteran status to assist with their employment application should send an e-mail to their recruiter directly. You'll work on the in-product journey from a user's first visit through sign-up, trial, and first purchase, on both GitLab.com and self-managed GitLab. You'll collaborate closely with Product Managers, UX Designers, and Data Analysts, with a particular focus on backend development in Ruby on Rails and frontend work in Vue.js. outcomes.</p> <p><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/engineering/development/growth/">Some examples of our projects:</a></p> <ul> <li value="1">Making it easier for self-managed users to try value="4">Improving the tooling the team uses to run and read out experiments</li> </ul> <h2>What you'll do</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Design, build, and iterate on A/B tests and experiments that title: Staff Product Manager, Agentic Planning
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>What does software planning look like when people and artificial intelligence agents work together? As a Staff Product Manager for Planning at GitLab, you'll help answer that question and lead the team toward a clear product direction. This isn't just about improving traditional agile planning. You'll rethink how intent becomes actionable work, how that work moves through software development, and where human involvement is needed.</p> <p>You'll develop a point of view on planning's future and turn it into product decisions with engineering, design, and product leadership. That includes exploring how planning could connect work to business priorities and budgets, rather than assuming the answer is already decided. Alongside that strategic work, you'll share ownership of existing planning capabilities with another product manager.</p> <p>We're opening this role at Staff level, with flexibility to consider Principal level based on your experience and scope of impact.</p> <h2><strong>What you'll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Define a clear direction for planning as software development shifts toward collaboration between people and artificial intelligence agents, and help the team move from open questions to concrete priorities.</li> <li>Shape how users capture intent, break it into actionable work, and determine which work can proceed autonomously and which needs human involvement.</li> <li>Evaluate whether and how planning should connect software delivery to company priorities, business objectives, and budgets.</li> <li>Share ownership of planning capabilities, including work items, boards, specifications, and portfolio planning, with a fellow product manager. Help define how that scope is divided.</li> <li>Work with engineering and design to translate product direction into a roadmap and improvements to planning workflows across GitLab.</li> <li>Communicate your recommendations clearly to senior leaders, challenge assumptions constructively, and lead the team through changes in direction.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you'll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience leading product strategy and execution for software development, developer tools, or planning products, with the depth to make decisions in a specialized product area.</li> <li>A strong understanding of software development and development and operations (DevOps) workflows, including how planning decisions affect downstream delivery.</li> <li>The ability to form and defend a product point of view in an uncertain, changing market, while staying open to different ideas.</li> <li>Clear communication with technical teams and senior executives, including experience challenging leadership decisions constructively and building support for a direction.</li> <li>The ability to connect a forward-looking strategy to practical product decisions and work collaboratively across product, engineering, and design.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>The Planning team builds the capabilities at the start of GitLab's software development workflow, including work items, boards, specifications, and portfolio planning. Decisions here affect how work moves through the rest of the platform, so the team's scope extends beyond standalone project management tools.</p> <p>You'll work alongside another product manager and partner with engineering and design across this product area. The division of product ownership is still being shaped, and you'll help define it. The hiring manager wants you to bring a different perspective, question established approaches, and challenge senior leaders constructively, with room to influence decisions beyond your immediate product scope.</p> <p>GitLab's mission is to enable everyone to contribute to and co-create the software that powers our world. Our platform brings software development, security, and operations together.</p> <p> </p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. title: Remote Senior Agentic AI / CI/CD Software Engineer
description: For a leading Swiss organisation, we are looking for an experienced Senior / Principal Agentic AI & CI/CD Software Engineer to support a strategic Agentic Engineering initiative. The project focuses on establishing secure, scalable and repeatable engineering practices for AI agent capabilities, modernising software delivery processes, and improving engineering productivity through automation and measurable development metrics. The ideal candidate combines strong hands-on CI/CD engineering expertise with a solid understanding of software supply chain security, GitHub/Bitbucket ecosystems and emerging Agentic AI development practices. The assignment is structured into two phases: Phase 1 (November–December 2026) : Initial implementation, validation and delivery of key engineering capabilities. Phase 2 (January–March 2027): Continuous improvement, integration enhancements and optimisation based on pilot feedback Agentic AI Skills & Lifecycle Management Establish secure and repeatable processes for validating, reviewing, approving and publishing AI agent skills. Implement governance and quality controls for agent skills and related engineering workflows. Demonstrate a complete skill lifecycle, including version management and rollback capabilities. Ensure compliance with internal security guidelines and engineering standards. CI/CD Engineering & DevSecOps Design, implement and optimise secure CI/CD pipelines and reusable workflows. Develop automated quality gates, validation mechanisms and secure deployment processes. Work with containers, runners, scripting and Infrastructure as Code (IaC). Implement security controls for dependencies, packages, secrets and access permissions. Improve developer experience and engineering productivity through automation. GitHub, Bitbucket & Engineering Metrics Extract, process and analyse repository data using GitHub and Bitbucket APIs. Support the migration and preservation of Bitbucket repository history, including commits, pull requests, reviews and associated metadata. Establish reproducible engineering performance baselines. Develop and validate aggregated SDLC and DORA metrics, including lead time, review performance and quality indicators. Ensure exported repository information remains accessible, consistent and verifiable. Engineering Scaffold & Integration Contribute hands-on engineering improvements to an existing development scaffold and tooling ecosystem. Develop and test targeted integrations and workflow enhancements. Collaborate with internal architects and engineering teams to ensure architectural alignment. Translate pilot feedback into prioritised technical improvements. Provide technical documentation, knowledge transfer and structured handover. Several years of professional experience in Software Engineering, Platform Engineering, DevOps or CI/CD Engineering. Strong hands-on expertise in building and maintaining secure CI/CD pipelines. Advanced knowledge of GitHub, Bitbucket, Git workflows and repository APIs. Practical experience with reusable workflows, runners, containers, scripting and Infrastructure as Code. Solid understanding of DevSecOps and software supply chain security. Experience with dependency validation, trusted sources, secrets management, access controls and secure automation. Proven ability to extract, transform and analyse software development metrics, including SDLC and DORA indicators. Strong troubleshooting, integration and technical documentation skills. Ability to work independently in complex enterprise engineering environments. English proficiency at C1 level or higher. Availability during Swiss business hours.
