title: Business Development Representative, Spanish Speaking
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>This position is 100% remote and will be based in Spain.<br><br>GitLab is looking for an enthusiastic and strategic Business Development Representative (BDR) to join our growing Sales team. As a BDR at GitLab, you get the opportunity to lead the initial outreach to targeted accounts working in conjunction with the Field and Digital Marketing teams as well as the Sales and Customer Success teams. In this role you'll leverage creative marketing and sales tactics to prospect and engage with multiple buyer personas and roles to introduce GitLab's AI-powered DevSecOps platform. You'll be responsible for generating qualified meetings and pipeline for GitLab's Sales organization.</p> <p>Our BDRs come from a diverse background. Many have worked in closing roles previously or managed teams.</p> <p>We have an extensive onboarding and training program at GitLab and you'll be provided with necessary DevOps and GitLab knowledge to fulfill your role.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Execute outbound prospecting initiatives to generate qualified meetings and pipeline in your assigned territory.</li> <li>Generate New Logo opportunities and Growth opportunities on existing customer accounts.</li> <li>Conduct high-level discovery conversations with target accounts to understand business needs, qualify opportunities, and create Sales Accepted Opportunities (SAOs).</li> <li>Meet or exceed monthly and quarterly BDR-sourced Sales Accepted Opportunity (SAO) targets (e.g., Stage 1 and Stage 3 opportunities) by consistently converting qualified prospects into opportunities.</li> <li>Research and prioritize target accounts using business and industry knowledge to identify key players, uncover compelling events, and develop tailored outreach strategies.</li> <li>Execute a multi-touch outreach cadence (call, email, social, etc.) to all prospects in your assigned territory using Outreach to maximize engagement and conversion rates.</li> <li>Manage, track, and accurately report all prospecting activities and pipeline in Salesforce to provide clear visibility into performance and forecast.</li> <li>Collaborate with Field, Corporate, and Digital Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success teams to build targeted account lists, campaigns, and call strategies. Attend regional marketing events to engage participants, generate leads, and drive qualified Sales Accepted Opportunities (SAOs).</li> <li>Document and continuously improve Business Development Representative processes in the GitLab handbook in partnership with your Business Development Manager. Mentor new BDR hires to help them ramp quickly and navigate key accounts.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Fluency in Spanish.</li> <li>Previous tech industry experience in an outbound sales development role is required.</li> <li>Positive and energetic phone skills, excellent listening skills, strong writing skills.</li> <li>Ability to prioritize tasks, manage a high volume of outreach, and consistently follow through on prospecting activities.</li> <li>Proven experience taking initiative, persisting through setbacks, and independently driving projects or activities through to successful outcomes.</li> <li>Alignment with our values and working in accordance with those values.</li> <li>Knowledge of business process, roles, and organizational structure.</li> <li>Proficiency in using Salesforce, Sales Navigator, and Outreach or similar prospecting and sequencing tools.</li> <li><span style="font-size: 10pt;">The ability to travel for events such as trainings, team offsites, customer meetings, etc.</span></li> <li>Proficiency in English, our company language, is required for effective communication.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>As part of GitLab's growing Sales team, you will work closely with the Field and Digital Marketing teams, as well as the Sales and Customer Success teams. Our BDRs come from diverse backgrounds, and we provide extensive onboarding and training so you have the DevOps and GitLab knowledge you need to succeed. You'll partner with Account Executives, working fully remote and distributed across multiple U.S. time zones, collaborating asynchronously through GitLab, video calls, and shared playbooks. This role provides a clear path for advancing to an Account Executive position within GitLab.</p> <div class="c-message_actions__container c-message__actions"> </div> <div><span style="font-size: xx-small;"><span style="color: white;">Remote-Global</span></span></div><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  </p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#equal-employment-opportunity-policy" target="_blank">GitLab’s EEO Policy</a> and <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/labor-and-employment-notices/#eeoc-us-equal-employment-opportunity-commission-notices" target="_blank">EEO is the Law</a>. If you have a disability or special need that requires <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#reasonable-accommodation" target="_blank">accommodation</a>, please let us know during the <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/interviewing/#adjustments-to-our-interview-process" target="_blank">recruiting process</a>.</p></div>

description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>As a Subject Matter Expert (SME), you'll be the deepest technical voice in the field for one product group, helping customers make technical decisions on GitLab's most important opportunities, roughly the top 10% by size or complexity.</p> <p>Account Solutions Architects (Account SAs) will bring you into prioritized opportunities. The Account SA owns the opportunity; you own your product group's success within it. You'll work directly with Product and Engineering, bringing customer needs and field insights into roadmap discussions. You'll also help the wider Solutions Architecture team build expertise through reusable assets, enablement, and coaching.</p> <p>You'll specialize in one product group, not all four. In Security & Compliance, you'll focus on GitLab Ultimate, application security, Dependency Firewall, software supply chain security, compliance, and artificial intelligence (AI) governance. In Platform, you'll focus on GitLab Dedicated, self-managed deployments, bring your own model, and cloud and hybrid architecture. In Core DevSecOps, you'll focus on GitLab Premium, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), source code management, Orbit, Artifact Central, and migrations. DevSecOps brings development, security, and operations together across software delivery. In AI & Competitive, you'll focus on GitLab Duo Agent Platform, agentic workflows, AI-native development, competitive displacement including GitHub, and migrations.</p> <p>Your success will be measured by technical win rate and bookings on SME-engaged opportunities, product-category commit attainment and consumption growth in your region, and Proof of Value (PoV) conversion rate, evaluation cycle time, and time from technical win to production use. We'll also measure how often Account SAs reuse your assets, their confidence in handling your product group without escalation, and the quality and impact of your feedback to Product.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Act as the technical authority for your product group on prioritized opportunities, from discovery and architecture through trials and PoV evaluations.</li> <li>Lead technical deep dives, workshops, and executive briefings that connect product capabilities to business outcomes and explain how GitLab differs from competing solutions.</li> <li>Design and improve standardized PoV templates with clear, repeatable success criteria. Account SAs own the customer PoV; you'll contribute product-specific content and expertise while keeping the evaluation connected to the broader GitLab platform.</li> <li>Equip account teams for product launches with Product Management and Product Marketing. Build demos and talk tracks, and turn early customer wins into reference stories.</li> <li>Serve as the escalation point for Account SAs and Post-Sales Solutions Architects (Post-Sales SAs) on complex product questions, integrations, and objections.</li> <li>Hand off PoV success criteria and architecture decisions to the Post-Sales SA with the account team when an opportunity closes. Stay involved until the customer's first production workload uses the product, and support complex accounts when Post-Sales SAs bring you in to drive adoption and consumption.</li> <li>Bring structured field feedback, competitive insights, and customer requirements to Product Management and Engineering with the wider SME team. Help manage early-access and design-partner programs, and represent GitLab through customer events, conferences, industry working groups, and published content.</li> <li>Build reference architectures, demo environments, competitive battlecards, PoV playbooks, and enablement content so account teams can handle more opportunities without your direct involvement. Mentor Account SAs and contribute to GitLab's global SME community of practice.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Substantial experience in technical pre-sales, solutions architecture, consulting, or software engineering, with deep, hands-on expertise in one domain: application security testing, supply chain security, and compliance; scalable cloud and hybrid platforms; large CI/CD environments and source code migrations; or production AI-assisted development, working prototypes, and competitive evaluations.</li> <li>Practical expertise in agentic and AI-assisted development workflows across planning, coding, testing, security, and delivery, applied in a customer-facing, pre-sales context.</li> <li>Experience winning technical decisions on large, complex enterprise opportunities through structured Proof of Concept (PoC) or PoV evaluations with defined success criteria and executive sign-off.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with Git, CI/CD, containers, Kubernetes, and at least one major cloud provider.</li> <li>The ability to lead a whiteboard session with engineers and present the business case to executives in the same meeting.</li> <li>Strong written communication, including the ability to turn complex topics into clear playbooks that others use.</li> <li>Comfort working asynchronously across time zones with Sales, Product, and Engineering.</li> <li>Optional: public speaking, published technical content, open source contributions, or relevant certifications in Kubernetes, cloud architecture, or security.</li> </ul> <p>If you bring transferable experience in an adjacent domain, we encourage you to apply.</p> <h2><strong><br>About the team</strong></h2> <p>We're building our SME organization within GitLab's Solutions title: Partner Sales Director - Global System Integrator (GSI)
description: <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. title: SDK Engineer - Python
description: ABOUT SUPABASE Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth. ABOUT THE ROLE We're looking for a SDK Engineer - Python to join our SDK team and own how developers talk to Supabase from Python. You'll work closely with the rest of the SDK team, our Auth, Realtime, Storage, PostgREST, Functions, CLI and Docs teams, and the open-source community, helping us make the Python SDK a library Python developers genuinely enjoy using. Python developers reach Supabase from backend services, data pipelines, notebooks, and a growing number of AI agents and agent frameworks. The Python SDK is how all of them talk to the platform: database queries, auth, storage, realtime and edge functions, in both sync and async flavors. This is a library-authoring role, and the work happens in the open: public repos, public issue trackers, and API decisions whose consequences last for years. If you get satisfaction from a type checker that catches the bug before your users do, from an async client that cleans up after itself, and from an issue tracker that isn't a graveyard, you'll like it here. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in async, fast-paced environments and is excited about building developer tools that scale to millions. WHAT YOU'LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR - Build and evolve our Python SDK across database, auth, storage, realtime and functions, with both sync and async APIs that feel natural in Python. - Start new things. Alongside the maintenance work, find what's missing, make the case for it, and build it. Nobody will hand you the list. - Work in the open. Triage inbound issues, review and shepherd outside contributions, keep CI and release automation healthy, and hold a clear, kind line on scope. - Own the typing experience. Make the SDK fully typed and checker-friendly, so autocomplete and static analysis stay correct in real codebases. - Keep us honest across environments. Multiple Python versions, sync and async frameworks, workers, serverless and notebooks — with dependency ranges that don't fight our users' projects. Test it, don't assume it. - Work on realtime. Long-lived websocket connections, reconnection, and subscription and presence semantics. - Track the platform. When auth, realtime, storage, postgrest or edge functions ship a change, make sure the SDK reflects it, and that we say so in the changelog. - Design in public. Write the RFCs, migration guides, release notes and docs. Treat a breaking change as a deprecation path plus a migration story, not a version bump. - Make our SDK legible to AI coding agents, which are now a major consumer of it. YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU - Know modern Python typing deeply. You use generics, protocols, overloads and TypedDict as design tools, run strict type checking, and fix type errors without reaching for Any. - Have authored or maintained a published library with a public API and users outside your own company. You know what it costs to change something people depend on. - Know the maintainer side of open source. Issue triage at volume, reviewing outside PRs, release automation, changelogs and semver, security reports, and saying no to a feature request without losing the person who asked. - Are fluent in asyncio and have opinions on how a library should serve both sync and async callers. - Know Python packaging for libraries: pyproject.toml, wheels, modern tooling, version support policy, and why libraries shouldn't pin their dependencies tightly. - Test as a habit: unit, type-level and end-to-end against a real stack. Every fix comes with a regression test. - Write well. Design docs, changelogs and issue replies are a large part of the output here, much of it public, and we're async by default. - Have real autonomy: you find the important work, scope it, ship it, and say what you didn't do. - Communicate clearly across both technical and non-technical audiences - Have experience in async or globally distributed teams - Are energized by solving real-world problems for developers - Are comfortable navigating ambiguity and moving quickly Bonus points if you: have run a major-version migration for a public package, know your way around JWT/OAuth, have built integrations for AI agent frameworks, or have generated idiomatic clients from a schema. WHAT WE OFFER - Fully Remote We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world. - ESOP Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together. - Tech Allowance Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work. - Health Benefits Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us. - Annual Off-Sites Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year. - Flexible Work We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when. - Professional Development Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth. ABOUT THE TEAM Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love. - ~400 team members - 60+ countries - 20+ languages spoken - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F) - 540,000+ community members We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

title: Strategic Account Executive - San Francisco
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><p><strong>This is a future opportunity that may not be immediately available, but we're proactively building our pipeline of exceptional talent. At GitLab, we believe in connecting with outstanding professionals before we have an urgent need, allowing us to move quickly when the right moment arises. If you are excited about co-creating the future as we're building the most comprehensive AI-powered DevSecOps platform, we want to hear from you. </strong></p> <h2>Location: San Francisco </h2> <h2>An overview of this role</h2> <p>As a Strategic Account Executive on our AMER Enterprise team, you'll help large, regulated organizations adopt, implement, and expand their use of GitLab’s AI-powered DevSecOps platform. You’ll focus on strategic enterprise prospects and customers, guiding them through complex DevSecOps and software delivery transformations across areas like CI/CD automation, secure development, and infrastructure modernization. In this role, you'll act as a key connector between customer stakeholders and GitLab’s field organization so GitLab is seen as a trusted, long-term partner before, during, and after the sale. In your first year, you’ll be expected to build and manage a healthy enterprise pipeline, create repeatable sales motions, and drive successful rollouts and adoption that translate into measurable results and long-term expansion.</p> <h2>What you'll do</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Support GitLab’s strategic large prospects and customers as a trusted advisor throughout their DevSecOps journey.</li> value="3">Provide strong account leadership and direction in both the pre-sales and post-sales process to ensure customers realize value from GitLab’s AI-powered DevSecOps platform.</li> <li value="4">Coordinate closely with Solutions Architects, Customer Success, Support, and strategic channel partners to design and execute account strategies that drive adoption, expansion, and retention.</li> <li value="5">Develop and execute structured account plans based on customer business needs, including opportunity mapping, stakeholder alignment, and multi-threaded engagement across technical and business teams.</li> <li value="6">Ensure successful rollout and ongoing adoption through proactive account management activities, regular business reviews, and clear alignment on customer outcomes.</li> <li value="7">Prepare and deliver accurate activity and forecast reports, and contribute to root cause analysis on wins and losses while sharing lessons learned with account managers, marketing, and technical teams.</li> <li value="8">Act as the voice of the customer by sharing feedback and product ideas, and use a consultative approach to create proposals, quotes, and presentations that clearly link GitLab’s solutions to customer business objectives.</li> </ul> <h2>What you'll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">A true desire to see customers achieve meaningful outcomes and long-term value from their investment in GitLab.</li> <li value="2">Experience driving complex B2B software sales cycles with large enterprises, ideally in DevSecOps, software development tools, or adjacent SaaS solutions.</li> <li value="3">Proven success selling into large, strategic organizations, with the ability to build trusted relationships with C-level and senior stakeholders across business and technical teams.</li> <li value="4">Able to provide a high degree of account management and control, working under minimal supervision on complex opportunities while maintaining clear communication and alignment.</li> <li value="5">Ability to generate new business and expand existing accounts through consultative, multi-stakeholder sales motions that result in sustainable, long-term partnerships.</li> <li value="6">Experience collaborating with strategic channel partners to develop opportunities, co-sell, and support successful customer adoption.</li> <li value="7">Excellent negotiation, presentation, and closing skills, with effective written and verbal communication that influences internal and external stakeholders.</li> <li value="8">Preferred experience with Git, software development tools, application lifecycle management, or security/application security tools.</li> <li value="9">You share our values and work in accordance with them, use GitLab in your daily work, and are able to travel if needed while following GitLab’s travel policy.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>The Enterprise Sales team is responsible for driving growth, adoption, and long-term value for GitLab's AI-powered DevSecOps platform with our largest and most strategic customers. As a Strategic Account Executive on the AMER Enterprise team, you'll be part of a distributed, all-remote team that works asynchronously across regions and partners closely with GitLab's sales engineering, marketing, and customer success teams. We value transparency, collaboration, and a consultative approach, and we support one another through shared account planning, regular deal reviews, and knowledge sharing focused on enterprise customers across regulated and large-scale environments.</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. fosters a successful and positive team environment.</li> <li>Hires, coaches and develops top talent into the team</li> <li>Drives a high performing sales organisation</li> <li>Leads by example whilst being a role model for the team</li> <li>Empowers individuals to grow their own business</li> </ul> <p><strong>What you'll bring</strong></p> <ul> <li>Demonstrated progressive experience in field sales, operations and leadership</li> <li>Data-informed sales management skills, including building repeatable processes, pipeline discipline, and forecast accuracy using Salesforce (or a similar CRM).</li> <li>Experience selling complex, high-value software solutions and expanding customer relationships within commercial accounts.</li> <li>Experience selling to Fortune 500; willingness to "roll up your sleeves" and sell</li> <li>Demonstrated progressive experience leading field sales teams using the MEDDPICC or similar sales methodology.</li> <li>Strong solution selling experience and experience elevating the team to be solution sellers</li> <li>Proven track record of meeting or exceeding performance objectives (revenue targets, pipeline targets, etc.)</li> <li>Ability to exercise effective judgment, sensitivity, creativity to changing needs and situations; title: Model Validation Senior Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍London or Remote (UK)  | 💰  £85,000 - £105,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance +<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> Benefits </a></p> <p><strong>⭐Our Model Oversight team</strong></p> <p>The second line of defence Model Oversight team (that’s us!) provides support to our colleagues in Borrowing, Fincrime & Fraud, Finance and Operations to help Monzo grow safely. We’re looking for a <strong>Model Validation Senior Manager - Gen AI</strong> to lead the teams’ oversight of Generative AI models/use cases (primarily built across Monzo’s Operations squads) to provide assurance that the models/use cases we use are not only good for Monzo but what's best for our customers.</p> <p><strong>🔑You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <p><strong>Driving the embedding of the Model Risk Framework for Generative AI use cases across Monzo</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead the collaboration with the first line of defence teams to strengthen policies, standards and procedures for Generative AI model, use case, system design and build, implementation, governance, monitoring and use.  Helping to embed best practice of Generative AI across the business. </li> <li>Own the setting and maintenance of Generative AI validation methods, evidence expectations and reusable technical assets with relevant 1LoD modelling teams, applicable across all model risk areas.</li> <li>Convert modelling/validation experience into controlled playbooks, tests and working examples that can be applied to 2LoD Validation standards and processes for all Generative AI models, use cases, systems overseen by the 2LoD Model Oversight team.</li> <li>Coach Generative AI validation methodologies, to 2LoD Model Oversight colleagues, whom already have transferable Machine Learning skills, to reduce reliance on any single specialist for the validation of Generative AI models, use cases, systems so it can be consistently applied across Financial, Credit and Fincrime/Fraud models. </li> </ul> <p><br><strong>Leading the 2LoD Oversight of Operational Model Risk</strong></p> <ul> <li>Perform, and oversee, independent model validations of new Operational models (primarily Generative AI models, use cases, systems),  and changes to existing, using proportionate modelling techniques depending on the level of complexity applied. This includes writing clear and impactful model validation reports and presenting the findings in relevant committees.</li> <li>Build relationships with first line of defence modelling teams that develop Operational Models, and wider risk teams, to support the embedding of the model risk framework to help Monzo grow safely. </li> <li>Review ongoing model performance monitoring to ensure Operational models are performing within risk thresholds and providing support to the relevant model development team when further action is required</li> <li>Monitoring and measuring the overall level of Operational model risk that Monzo operates, and driving action plans with first line teams and appropriate governance forums to mitigate residual model risk within desired risk appetite.</li> </ul> <p><br><strong>Being a senior advocate of Model Risk Management best practices</strong></p> <ul> <li>Support the effective operation of the Model Risk Oversight Committee as a regular attendee, contributing to the group discussion to improve model risk management.</li> <li>Promote and help embed a strong risk culture, making risk meaningful and relevant to everyone at Monzo. You will share best practice that is easy for everyone to understand.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You are highly motivated and energised by the idea of bringing positive impact to our customers and Monzo</li> <li>You are self-motivated and thrive in a fast-paced environment</li> <li>You have great attention to detail while keeping an eye on the big picture</li> <li>You are a great communicator, able to articulate complex problems</li> <li>You can provide effective challenge whilst building strong, respectful relationships</li> <li>You are keen to grow your knowledge in both business and technology</li> </ul> <p><strong>And, from a technical and knowledge perspective, you should have</strong>:</p> <ul> <li>Robust Data Science or Machine Learning background with strong Python capability</li> <li>Experience with design of Generative AI evaluation frameworks, architectures, methods, practical tooling and platform alignment.</li> <li>Knowledge of Gemini implementations and change assessment</li> <li>Experience of managing a modelling project through its full lifecycle</li> <li>If possible, some understanding of some of the following:</li> <ul> <li>Coaching and standard setting</li> <li>Banking MRM and regulatory context</li> </ul> </ul> <p><strong>🙌What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰£85,000 - £105,000 ➕ Incentive Awards tied to your performance</p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London or Cardiff offices, or be distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London)</p> <p>⏰We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>📚£1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>➕ Plus lots more!<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> Read our full list of benefits</a>.</p> <p><strong>🌈 The application journey has 4 key steps:</strong><strong><br></strong><strong><br></strong>- Phone call with recruiter - 30 mins<br>- Initial call with hiring manager - 30 mins<br>- Assessment & technical interview - 60 mins<br>- Leadership & Behavioural Interview - 60 mins </p> <p>This process should take around 4-8 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p>#LI-TK1</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

title: Controls Product Senior Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍London/Cardiff/UK Remote | 💰£85,000 - £115,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance +<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> Benefits</a>  ✨</p> <p>This role sits at the heart of our Control Discipline change agenda, building the controls product platform that powers safe growth at Monzo.</p> <p>At Monzo, we don’t treat risk and controls as a bureaucratic governance process. We treat our control framework, tools, and data pipelines as an internal <em>product</em> - designed to give engineers, product managers, and business leads the ability to ship fast - and safely.</p> <p>We are looking for a <strong><em>Senior Controls Product Manager</em></strong> to join our newly established Controls Product & Enablement team within our Controls Discipline. Sitting at the intersection of Product, Risk, Data, and Engineering, you will act as the Product Lead for Monzo’s core risk lifecycles (Issues, RCSAs, Controls, Policy, Reg Traceability). </p> <p>You won't just write requirement docs for someone else to build - you are a builder yourself. You’ll prototype low-code tools, leverage AI models, interrogate data pipelines, and architect automated workflows to turn manual risk friction into seamless, automated self-service.</p> <p><strong>⭐ Our Controls team</strong></p> <p>The role will sit within the <em>Controls Product & Enablement</em> team which is part of the wider Controls Discipline  in Monzo’s 1st line of defence  Our teams work closely with cross-functional teams across the organisation including Technology, Data, Product, Operations as well and Risk & Compliance (the 2nd line of defence).  </p> <p>As this is a newly established team (wherein you’ll have two direct reports already working in the team as data and automation specialists), this role holder needs to bring a flexible and adaptable mindset, as well as a willingness to deal with ambiguity as the team establishes its operating rhythm and embeds itself within the wider business.</p> <p><strong>🔑 What you’ll do (Your Product Ownership Scope)…</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the Controls Product Roadmap: Define the vision, strategy, and backlog for Monzo’s internal risk products, replacing static, manual cycles with smart, data-driven platforms (SmartSuite, Zango, Looker, and native AI integrations).</li> <li>Hands-on Prototyping & Automation: Directly design, prototype, and build automated workflows, API integrations, and low-code/no-code solutions. You'll take an idea from a problem statement to a working MVP before partnering with core Engineering (if necessary) to scale or industrialise it.</li> <li>Pioneer AI in Risk Management: Champion AI adoption across the discipline. Experiment with LLM prompting, custom agents, and automated evidence-gathering tools to solve complex control problems and dramatically reduce manual drag for Monzo staff.</li> <li>Build for Real-Time Risk Intelligence: Drive the shift from annual "point-in-time" assessments to continuous, automated monitoring. Design data triggers (e.g., incident spikes, change flags) that alert risk owners in real time.</li> <li>Product Enablement & Adoption: Ensure high-impact adoption. Work closely with first line risk owners and Risk Partners to deliver clear "write once" guidance, intuitive UI/UX workflows, and enablement that allows teams to self-serve effortlessly.</li> <li>Drive Execution & Delivery: Maintain momentum across the team’s delivery plan (guiding 2 specialised data/automation direct reports), keeping senior stakeholders engaged and removing blockers without bureaucratic overhead.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You think like a Product Manager: You obsess over user problems, value vs. effort prioritization, user experience, and shipping MVPs quickly.</li> <li>You are a Hands-On Builder: You can get under the hood with data and automation. You're comfortable with SQL, Python (or similar), APIs, workflow tools, or low-code environments to build a working prototype yourself.</li> <li>You’re AI-Curious & Practical: You actively experiment with AI/LLMs to automate manual tasks and make workflows smarter.</li> <li>You Understand Risk & Controls: You understand fundamental risk concepts (control design, RCSAs, issue management) and see the massive opportunity to transform them through tech.</li> <li>You Thrive in Ambiguity: You enjoy starting from first principles in a fast-paced environment and turning messy operational problems into slick, scalable digital solutions.</li> <li>You have experience in leading teams through change programmes, ideally within Financial Services Controls functions.</li> <li>You are hands-on and take satisfaction in supporting colleagues, projects or tasks however big or small - and can take a range of stakeholders on the journey with you</li> <li>You’re excited by what we’re doing at Monzo</li> </ul> <h3><strong>ℹ️ This role </strong><strong><em>isn’t </em></strong><strong>for you if…</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Your technology and data experience has primarily involved defining requirements for Data or Engineering teams to build, rather than building solutions yourself.</li> <li>You aren't comfortable getting hands-on with data, automation tooling and technical problem solving.</li> <li>You aren’t comfortable with ambiguity, or thinking from first principles</li> <li>You don’t enjoy working in a fast-paced environment</li> <li>You aren’t happy taking an MVP approach and doing what’s good enough for now with iterative changes to follow</li> <li>Equally, if your experience is primarily technical and you don't have sufficient understanding of risk and controls to translate control problems into effective solutions, this role is unlikely to be the right fit.</li> </ul> <p><br><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 £85,000 - £115,000 ➕Incentive Awards tied to your performance.</p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London) </p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. </p> <p>➕ Plus lots more!<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> Read our full list of benefits</a>.</p> <p><strong><br>🌈 The application journey has 3 key steps</strong></p> <ul> <li>Short call with a Monzo Recruiter</li> <li>Video-call with Hiring Manager (30 mins)</li> <li>Full-Loop: 3 x video-call interviews (covering Technical, Behaviours, and Leadership)</li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 4-5 weeks - title: AI Transformation Owner, Product & Design
location: Remote, Canada; Remote, United Kingdom; Remote, United States
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2>An overview of this role</h2> <p>As an AI Transformation Owner at GitLab, you'll shape your function's AI strategy and build the solutions that deliver it. You are the person responsible for identifying where AI can fundamentally change how your org operates, partnering with your Executive Sponsor to align on the biggest challenges, and driving measurable outcomes against them.</p> <p>Think of this as a product management role where the product is your org's way of working. You'll manage the full lifecycle: understanding how work flows today, deciding where AI should reshape it, prioritizing what gets built and in what order, and ensuring what ships actually gets adopted. You'll also prototype solutions, configure agents, and prove what's possible before pulling in engineering support to scale it.</p> <p>You will work closely with an AI Engineer who sits within the Enterprise AI team. Together you form a partnership: you bring the business context, process intelligence, and strategic prioritization. They bring the technical depth, production-grade delivery, and architecture decisions. You'll build working solutions at the no-code and low-code layer, and partner with the AI Engineer on the right approach, tooling, and structure.</p> <h2>What you'll do</h2> <h3>Strategy & Prioritization</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Own your function's AI strategy,</strong> aligned with your Executive Sponsor and business priorities. Understand which metrics matter to the org, identify what will move the needle, define how you'll measure impact, and track progress over time.</li> <li><strong>Map how work flows</strong> across your function end-to-end, including the handoffs upstream and downstream to other orgs. Identify where the real constraints are, not just the ones your team can see. Focus on the 100x problems: where could leveraging AI in a workflow let your org execute it orders of magnitude faster, or at 100x more volume than before?</li> <li><strong>Manage intake</strong> of AI requests, ideas, and pain points from across the function, including via your Champion network. Ensure every team member has a clear route to surface what they need, rather than building independently.</li> <li><strong>Prioritize strategically</strong> against business outcomes and executive guidance. Hold the line on priorities - we cannot change direction every two weeks - and ensure the AI Engineer's time is spent on the highest-impact work.</li> </ul> <h3>Adoption & Change Management</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Reimagine, not just automate.</strong> Challenge your org to think beyond injecting AI into existing workflows. Work with Enterprise AI to spot opportunities to fundamentally rethink how work gets done.</li> <li><strong>Drive adoption and change management</strong> together with the AI Engineer. The best AI solution is worthless if nobody uses it. Create the channels, rituals, and feedback loops that make AI visible in your function: shared spaces for teams to show what they've built, regular office hours, onboarding for new hires, and celebration of wins. Own the rollout and iteration needed to make AI initiatives stick.</li> <li><strong>Coordinate with Enterprise AI</strong> to ensure your function benefits from patterns, tools, and learnings emerging across other parts of the business.</li> <li><strong>Build and bridge the Champion network in your function.</strong> Champions are the peer community that extends your reach beyond what you and the AI Engineer can deliver directly. From early in the role, identify and recruit Champions across sub-teams (5-10% time, formally agreed with their manager), run a regular Champion sync, host demos to the wider function, and act as their bridge to Enterprise AI. Champions are not your reports: you coordinate them, you don't manage them. Without this network, your reach is capped.</li> </ul> <h3>Hands-On Building & Agent Operations</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Build AI agents</strong> using no-code and low-code platforms (e.g. Glean, Workato, similar tools). Go from idea to working prototype without waiting for engineering.</li> <li><strong>Author and iterate on skills files</strong> that define how AI agents behave. Refine instructions based on real usage and share reusable skills across the function.</li> <li><strong>Configure MCP servers and tools,</strong> giving agents access to the business systems they need. Partner with the AI Engineer on what to connect and how to do it securely.</li> <li><strong>Own your function's fleet of agents.</strong> Some agents will be used directly by people in your org. Those that aren't, you own. Either way, you're accountable for their performance: tracking KPIs, running evaluations after model or data changes, and iterating based on what you learn.</li> <li><strong>Expect to rebuild.</strong> AI tools and models evolve fast. The agent you built last month may need to be replaced, not patched. You should be comfortable sunsetting your own work when a better approach emerges, and helping your org stay current rather than attached to what exists today.</li> </ul> <h2>What you'll bring</h2> <h3>Business & Strategic</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Deep knowledge of your function's operations.</strong> You understand how work moves through your org, where it gets stuck, and why. You can trace a process end-to-end and explain how it connects to the teams around it.</li> <li><strong>Strategic prioritization skills.</strong> You've managed competing demands before and can make hard calls about what matters most. You think in terms of business outcomes, not activity.</li> <li><strong>A product management mindset.</strong> You naturally think about intake, backlog, iteration, and adoption. You're comfortable defining success metrics and holding yourself accountable to them.</li> <li><strong>Strong communication and influence.</strong> You'll be the person saying "not yet" to some teams and "think bigger" to others. You need the credibility and interpersonal skills to make both of those conversations land.</li> <li><strong>Cross-functional instincts.</strong> You default to understanding how your org's processes affect and are affected by the teams around you - not just optimising in isolation.</li> <li><strong>Experience building peer networks or communities of practice.</strong> You've recruited and sustained volunteer contributors before, whether as a guild lead, champion program owner, or community organizer. You know how to motivate people whose time you don't directly own.</li> </ul> <h3>Hands-On & Technical</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Comfortable building with AI tools.</strong> You don't need to write production code, but you should be able to build a working agent, configure a skill, connect an MCP server, and troubleshoot when something isn't working. Think: power user, not software engineer.</li> <li><strong>Ready to learn fast.</strong> Experience with or willingness to quickly pick up no-code/low-code AI platforms, prompt engineering, and agent configuration. You'll be trained on GitLab's specific tooling, but you should arrive ready to get your hands dirty.</li> <li><strong>Strong conceptual understanding of AI capabilities</strong> - summarization, classification, generation, automation, agentic workflows - and a commitment to staying current. The landscape shifts constantly. The tools you use today may be obsolete in weeks. You stay on top of new developments so that your org's AI strategy reflects what's actually possible, not what was possible six months ago.</li> <li><strong>Ability to map data flows</strong> - structured and unstructured. Understand where agents need context, and figure out where humans should interface with automated workflows and at what steps.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>You will partner closely with Enterprise AI within the Enterprise Technology & AI organization, while remaining embedded in your own function. Enterprise AI provides the technical delivery capability, platforms, and patterns. You provide the business context, prioritization, building at the no-code layer, and adoption muscle. Together, you form the core of your function's AI transformation.</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. That covers how agents are created, shared and connected to tools inside and outside GitLab, how they run, and how their work shows up and can be observed across GitLab.</p> <p>In this role you'll work closely with engineers across the stage and other AI Engineering teams. This is a high-visibility area where GitLab's core platform meets its AI strategy.</p> <h2><strong>What you'll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Develop, ship and maintain features for the Duo Agent Platform in the GitLab monolith (Ruby) and, where needed, the AI Gateway (Python). Familiarity with Python backends and/or Vue frontends is a plus.</li> <li>Skill in designing or extending REST and/or GraphQL APIs with attention to scalability, maintainability and backward compatibility.</li> <li>Real enthusiasm for AI and hands-on experience using AI tools in your daily work. Experience designing and shipping AI-powered backend features or integrations is a plus.</li> <li>Proven SQL and experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL, including writing efficient queries and data modeling.</li> <li>Experience finding and fixing performance bottlenecks in applications.</li> <li>Clear written and verbal communication, including technical proposals and documentation, in a remote, async, cross-functional team.</li> <li>Openness to learning and to applying skills from related technologies or fields.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>The <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/engineering/ai/agent-foundations/">Agent Foundations stage</a> builds the foundations for GitLab's agentic AI experiences. We provide the platform, catalog and execution features that help teams deliver resilient agents and flows to customers. We work with teams across AI engineering and the rest of GitLab so the Duo Agent Platform can power many of GitLab's AI features.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. This role will help enable communication, collaboration, strategy execution, and special projects across the CRO organization. </p> <ul> <li>Serve as a trusted advisor and thought partner to the CRO and revenue leadership on strategy, initiatives, and organizational priorities</li> <li>Drive leadership operations , including weekly executive staff meetings, QBRs, and strategic planning cycles with insights that inform decision-making</li> <li>Lead the CRO team's goal-setting and tracking across the global revenue organization</li> <li>Effectively triage escalations and drive cross-functional resolution of complex business blockers and time-sensitive customer issues</li> <li>Serve as CRO proxy in reviewing account plans, preparing briefing materials, and managing key customer and partner meetings with clear agendas and follow-ups</li> <li>Ensure timely follow-up on critical customer and partner interactions to drive business outcomes</li> <li>Serve as CRO Board Liaison, prepare board materials, investor updates, and collaborate on executive presentations and organizational announcements</li> <li>Maintain strategic partnerships with CEO's Chief of Staff, Sales Strategy & Analytics, Field Operations, Finance, and People teams to drive cross-functional alignment</li> <li>Develop and maintain strong relationships with executives and senior leaders to achieve project objectives and deliverables</li> <li>Identify delegation opportunities and optimize the CRO's time allocation to ensure focus on the highest-value strategic activities</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What you'll bring</strong></h3> <ul> <li>8-12 years of progressive experience in strategic roles such as chief of staff, top-tier management consulting, corporate strategy, or revenue operations leadership at high-growth technology companies. You combine strategic thinking with exceptional execution skills and thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous environments.</li> <li>Proven track record leading cross-functional projects, influencing senior stakeholders, and delivering results in matrixed organizations</li> <li>Executive presence and confidence in managing conversations with Board members, C-Suite, and senior leaders across the organization</li> <li>Strong analytics and reporting capabilities with experience translating data into actionable insights that drive business decisions</li> <li>Advanced proficiency in CRM systems (Salesforce), business intelligence tools, and presentation software</li> <li>Demonstrated success in building scalable processes and operating systems that improve organizational efficiency</li> <li>Exceptional organizational and time management skills with the ability to shift priorities quickly while maintaining control across multiple projects</li> <li>Collaborative mindset with strong emotional intelligence and ability to work effectively across all organizational levels and functions</li> <li>Detail-oriented and results-driven with strong initiative, self-motivation, and a bias toward action</li> <li>Exceptional written communication, comfort documenting in public, and experience operating in an async environment</li> <li>Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, or related field (or equivalent work experience)</li> <li>Ability to travel as needed to support the CRO</li> </ul> <p><strong>About the Team</strong></p> <p>The GitLab Revenue Team builds and scales the go-to-market capabilities that power our global growth and customer success. Acting as strategic partners to customers and internal stakeholders, the team aligns revenue solutions with company objectives to acquire, expand, and retain world-class customers.<br><br></p> <p>The Revenue Team spans multiple functions working in coordination: Sales teams drive new business and expansion across territories and segments; Customer Success ensures adoption and value realization; Sales Strategy & Analytics provides insights and enablement; Field Operations optimizes processes and systems; and Partner teams extend our market reach through channel and alliance relationships. As a fully distributed, async-first team, the Revenue Team serves as the growth engine of the company, provides data-driven insights on pipeline and forecast, and champions initiatives that strengthen market execution while modeling the collaboration practices that enable GitLab's remote culture to thrive at scale.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Your first-year outcomes will focus on building trusted advisor relationships, enabling successful customer implementations, and creating reusable workshops and technical content that helps customers adopt GitLab at scale.</p> <h2><strong>What you'll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Engage with customers through Zoom calls and email as a technical consultant during the post-sales journey, providing product, solution, and best practice guidance.</li> <li>Partner with Customer Success Managers to provide in-depth guidance on GitLab use case implementation, including source code management, continuous integration, continuous delivery, DevSecOps, and Agile Planning.</li> <li>Deliver practical, customer-specific enablement through webinars, hands-on labs, office hours, and on-demand engagements in a pooled support model that isn't dedicated to a single account.</li> <li>Provide technical and architectural guidance that helps customers adopt GitLab capabilities and connect technical decisions to the outcomes they care about.</li> <li>Align with Account Executives and Renewals Managers to share customer-facing subject matter expertise that supports customer business objectives.</li> <li>Develop and deliver workshops, demos, and other reusable enablement content in collaboration with cross-functional partners.</li> <li>Build and maintain specialty competency in one or more technologies aligned with GitLab's market focus through training, certification, and working examples for internal and customer use.</li> <li>Contribute to customer-facing learning resources, including GitLab documentation, YouTube content, and enablement programs such as the Digital Journey.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you'll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Fluency in English and Spanish. Trilingual candidates who speak English, Spanish, and Brazilian Portugese is a strong plus. </li> <li>Located in the United States, Mexico, and Brazil. </li> <li>Experience supporting one or more GitLab use cases, such as source code management, continuous integration, continuous delivery, DevSecOps, or Agile Planning, and enabling customers with practical, in-depth guidance.</li> <li>Proficiency with DevSecOps tools or adjacent technical tooling, with the ability to translate tool capabilities into customer outcomes.</li> <li>A technical background in software development or systems engineering, including comfort discussing architecture, workflows, and implementation tradeoffs.</li> <li>The ability to communicate complex technical and organizational topics clearly in writing and live settings, including Zoom calls, workshops, and presentations.</li> <li>Experience operating as a trusted technical advisor to customer and business stakeholders in a post-sales environment.</li> <li>Strong time management and prioritization skills, including the ability to manage multiple customer engagements and cross-functional requests in a pooled model.</li> <li>A continuous learning mindset, including maintaining specialty competency through training, certification, documentation, or reusable examples. We welcome transferable experience from related roles and backgrounds.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>We're a globally distributed Customer Success Engineer team supporting customers in GitLab's On-Demand Success Tier. We collaborate asynchronously and stay aligned through clear documentation and shared enablement assets. We continuously improve our content and delivery based on what we learn from customer engagements.</p> <h4> </h4> <h4><strong>How GitLab will support you</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/" target="_blank">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/paid-time-off/" target="_blank">Flexible Paid Time Off</a> </li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/erg-guide/#:~:text=Definition%20of%20the%20TMRG%20%2D%20Team%20Member%20Resource%20Groups,-TMRGs%20are%20voluntary&text=The%20purpose%20for%20this%20type,developing%20the%20sense%20of%20belonging." target="_blank">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/" target="_blank">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/" target="_blank">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave" target="_blank">Parental leave</a> </li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/finance/expenses/#equipment" target="_blank">Home office</a> support</li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. title: Director, Analytics Engineering
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>As Director, Analytics Engineering, you'll lead a team of 8 and report to the VP of Data & Insights. You set direction across the data organization, stay close enough to the work to guide technical decisions credibly, and partner with Data Engineering, Data Science, IT, and business leaders.<br>You will have three mandates:</p> <ol> <li><strong>Build trusted, AI-ready self-service.</strong> Deliver a semantic model that answers business questions correctly, with the telemetry, evals, and model flexibility to prove it and keep costs in check.</li> <li><strong>Set the strategy for how GitLab accesses data.</strong> Own the data models, BI tools, and AI access patterns (Claude, MCP servers, Slack agents) that put trusted data in everyone's hands.</li> <li><strong>Build data applications the whole company relies on.</strong> Ship production-grade apps that combine trusted data, APIs, and AI to answer questions dashboards can't.</li> </ol> <h2><strong>What you'll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Build and own a trusted semantic model, with governed metrics and business definitions, that answers business questions consistently across every tool</li> <li>Build evals and ground-truth datasets that measure answer quality, and use them to drive improvements and catch regressions</li> <li>Instrument telemetry to see who uses the semantic model and AI tools, what they ask, and where they get stuck</li> <li>Build a model-selection harness so GitLab can route work across LLMs and stay flexible on cost and quality</li> <li>Own data modeling and curated datasets for self-service, with the ownership, data contracts, testing, and documentation that make them AI-ready</li> <li>Define the AI data access strategy: when to use BI, Claude, MCP servers, or Slack agents, with the governance and security to keep access trusted and reliable</li> <li>Own the enterprise BI and self-service tools strategy (e.g., Tableau, Omni), including evaluation, adoption, and cost</li> <li>Build self-service capabilities, such as Claude skills, documentation, and guided workflows, that help people find and use data on their own</li> <li>Build and own company-wide data applications, from Claude-built single-page apps to apps inside BI tools, that combine Snowflake data, API calls, AI-powered deep dives, and write-back to Postgres or Snowflake</li> <li>Set engineering standards for data apps (security, authentication, testing, deployment, and monitoring) so they're reliable at company scale</li> <li>Set a long-range roadmap tied to company strategy, and a lightweight operating model that balances urgent stakeholder needs with investment in reusable data products and tech-debt reduction</li> <li>Hire, coach, and retain a high-performing team of 8: build career paths, develop leaders, distribute ownership, and recognize great work</li> <li>Act as customer zero for GitLab and GitLab Duo in data workflows, sharing feedback with Product and Engineering</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you'll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>12+ years in analytics engineering, data engineering, or BI, including 5+ years leading teams and 2+ years managing managers or senior leads</li> <li>Deep expertise in data modeling and semantic layers (e.g., dbt Semantic Layer, Snowflake semantic views, LookML, Cube), and expert dbt, including testing and CI/CD across a multi-team project</li> <li>Hands-on experience building LLM-powered data access (text-to-SQL, agents, MCP servers), including evals and telemetry for answer quality, and advanced use of AI coding agents such as Claude Code</li> <li>Expert SQL and strong Snowflake experience; working knowledge of Python</li> <li>Strong data governance experience: data quality, lineage, certified datasets, and access controls (RBAC, row access and masking policies)</li> <li>Track record of leading cross-functional data initiatives from strategy through adoption and measurable business impact, including enterprise BI and self-service at scale</li> <li>Systems thinker who sees how models, pipelines, and architecture decisions connect, and designs for second-order effects</li> <li>Exceptional communicator who writes clear technical specs, sets a clear vision, makes trade-offs visible, and influences executives and peers across the company</li> <li>Pragmatic in ambiguity: makes sound decisions on emerging technology and ships the right next version rather than waiting for the ideal end state</li> <li>Able to use GitLab, thrive in an all-remote, asynchronous company, model GitLab's remote working competencies, and work in line with GitLab's values</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Nice to Have</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience with LLM routing or gateway tools and managing model costs</li> <li>Experience with Tableau, Omni, or a BI platform migration</li> <li>Experience with web app development (e.g., React, TypeScript) and Postgres</li> <li>Experience owning finance or revenue-critical data (e.g., ARR, consumption) where accuracy and auditability are non-negotiable</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the Team</strong></h2> <p>Analytics Engineering makes GitLab's data trusted, easy to find, and ready for anyone to use, whether they ask a dashboard, Claude, or a Slack agent. We own the curated data models, the semantic layer, the self-service tools, and the data applications that let teams answer their own questions.</p> <p>AI is changing how people get to data. Questions that once went through an analyst now go straight to AI tools, so the answers are only as good as the data models and business definitions behind them. Our job is to make those answers correct, consistent, and measurable.</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only.
