title: Head of AI Native Operations
description: ABOUT SUPABASE Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth. About the Role We are looking for a Head of AI Native Operations to build the autonomous systems that run Supabase. Supabase is building an AI-native internal operating system, where agents carry the operational load end to end. We are standing up a new central team to build that platform and run it in production. This is the role that leads it, and it is hands-on. You design the architecture, build the first versions of the critical pieces, and are accountable for whether every agent we run is correct, safe, and improving over time. We build rather than buy, and there are no settled best practices for most of this yet, so you will be setting them. You will lead a team of senior individual contributors extending the platform and driving adoption across teams. What You’ll Be Responsible For In this role, you’ll: - Own the agent platform architecture: The harness and orchestration layer and connectors into company systems, shared context and memory, and the path from prototype to production. - Catch regressions before they ship: Model, prompt, and tool changes can’t ship until they pass the evals. When a new model comes out, you know within hours whether to adopt it. - Make every agent observable: Every run and every decision is traced. For any agent at any time, you can answer what it did, why, what it cost, and how its quality is trending. - Own safety and trust: Design the controls that let agents act without a human in the loop: least-privilege credentials, hard policy limits, escalation thresholds, audit logs, sandboxing, and prompt-injection defenses. - Replace workflows, don’t assist them: Pick the workflows agents can fully own today and take them to production. - Turn wins into a platform: Package what works into reusable components, templates, and eval harnesses so other teams can ship their own production agents without starting from scratch. - Build and direct the team: Hire and grow senior ICs, review their designs and pull requests, and hold the quality bar. - Measure what matters: Track workflows automated, eval pass rates, cost per run, and work absorbed against the hiring plan. How You’ll Think A Point of View on Where Automation Wins You have a thesis about how AI and automation change the way a company operates, and it comes from building, not reading. You can look at a business and say which workflows agents can own today, which they will own in 12 months as models improve, and which still need people, and why. You defend that view with evidence from systems you have shipped, and you update it when the evals tell you to. Eval-Driven You don’t trust an agent because the demo looked good. You trust it because it passes a test set of real cases, and you know which cases it fails. When anything changes, your first question is “what do the evals say?” Inversion Thinking Left alone, an autonomous system tends to fail quietly, or people route around it. So the first question about any agent isn’t “does it work on the happy path?” but “how will this break, and how will we know?” The design follows from that answer: what the agent is never allowed to do, what it escalates, and which alert fires when quality drifts. Recursive Thinking Every system you build should produce the evidence that grades it. An agent isn’t done when it works. It’s done when it tells you, without you in the loop, that it has stopped working. Must Have - Hands-on agent building: Have personally designed and built autonomous agent or LLM systems that ran in production and that others depended on. Prototypes, demos, and configuring a vendor tool don’t count. You don’t need to be a career software engineer, but you must have built these systems yourself. - Architecture depth: Can explain how the pieces fit together (orchestration, tool and data access, context and memory, tracing, evals, guardrails, deployment), with opinions on current frameworks. - Security judgment: Have shipped agents that take real actions with real permissions, and designed the controls that made that safe. - A tested point of view: Can argue, with examples from your own builds, where autonomous systems create real business leverage and where they don’t yet. - Technical leadership: Have led senior builders and set the quality bar through design and code review. Strong Signal - Have replaced a human-run business workflow (finance, operations, support, release management) end to end with an autonomous system. - Are native to Git, Markdown, and pull requests, and comfortable reading and writing Python or TypeScript. - Have taken an internal platform from zero to adoption by teams you did not control. - A software engineering background is a plus, but not required. What Success Looks Like - Six months: 20+ autonomous agents in production on the shared platform, each with an eval suite, tracing, and a named owner. - Regressions get caught, not discovered: Quality problems surface in an alert or dashboard before a user reports them. - Workflows replaced, not assisted: Multiple high-volume workflows are fully owned by agents, with humans handling only escalations. - Trusted by default: No agent causes material financial, security, or customer harm, and every agent’s permissions and actions can be audited. - Teams ship their own: At least three teams outside the core team run production agents built on the platform. - Autonomous team: Your two reports work independently, and you spend your time on architecture and review rather than execution. WHAT WE OFFER - Fully Remote We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world. - ESOP Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together. - Tech Allowance Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work. - Health Benefits Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us. - Annual Off-Sites Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year. - Flexible Work We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when. - Professional Development Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth. ABOUT THE TEAM Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love. - ~400 team members - 60+ countries - 20+ languages spoken - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F) - 540,000+ community members We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

title: General Counsel (remote)
description: <p>We are hiring a <strong>General Counsel</strong>, reporting to the Chief Operating Officer (COO). This role leads Canonical’s global Legal and Compliance function.</p> <p>This is a unique opportunity for an <strong>exceptional and commercially-minded senior lawyer</strong> to lead the legal and compliance function of a profitable, fast-growing technology company that is privately held with the intention to list on a public exchange. We’re looking for someone with genuine fluency in the software industry and in open source dynamics, who can translate that insight into clear positions on licensing, commercial contracts and risk, and hands-on execution.</p> <p>Reporting directly to the Chief Operating Officer, you will <strong>own Canonical's legal, regulatory and governance posture</strong> and lead a distributed team across EMEA and the Americas. Your primary challenge will be to continue building both the team and the architecture: a management layer across two regions, and the governance, contracting and controls a public company needs, in an environment that regularly does things the industry has not done before. You will work closely with our product and engineering teams on licensing and IP questions, with the security function on customer assurance, and you will advise the Board and its committees directly.</p> <p>In our selection process, we <strong>prioritize intellect and judgement</strong> alongside depth of practice. We are looking for someone with a strong academic background, an active licence to practice, and demonstrable exposure to a multilayered global operational environment.</p> <p><strong><em>Location: </em></strong><em>This role will be based remotely in EMEA time zones.</em></p> <h3><strong>The role entails</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Leading the global Legal and Compliance function: setting it's structure, standards and priorities across EMEA and the Americas.</li> <li>Building and managing a management capability: hire and develop managers, set objectives, review performance against a clear bar, and address under-performance directly.</li> <li>Setting the operating cadence of the function: intake and prioritization of legal work, service expectations with internal clients, and reporting on workload and risk to the leadership team.</li> <li>Owning public-market readiness on the legal side: corporate governance, group and entity structure, delegated authority, policies, disclosure controls and records, in partnership with Finance.</li> <li>Advising the CEO, COO, CFO and the Board, and supporting in Board and committee meetings.</li> <li>Owning the commercial contracting framework: standard templates, negotiating positions, and a deviation and escalation process that makes commitments visible before they are signed.</li> <li>Leading intellectual property and open source licensing strategy, including copyleft, trademark and the terms on which Ubuntu and our products are distributed.</li> <li>Owning the global compliance programme: data protection and privacy, export controls and trade compliance, anti-bribery and corruption, competition and AI regulation.</li> <li>Managing litigation, disputes and regulatory engagement, together with the external counsel panel, its budget and its quality.</li> <li>Advising on M&A, partnerships, strategic alliances and financing as the company grows.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we are looking for in you</strong></h3> <ul> <li>An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university.</li> <li>A degree in law, or equivalent, and an active licence to practice in an EMEA or Americas jurisdiction.</li> <li>Substantial senior in-house experience in a global technology or software business.</li> <li>Proven experience leading a distributed legal team, including managing managers across regions and time zones.</li> <li>A track record of setting and holding a high performance bar: hiring well, developing people, and dealing with under performance directly rather than waiting it out.</li> <li>Experience building or restructuring an in-house legal function, including deciding what is retained, delegated and sent to external counsel.</li> <li>Technology related experience of: <ul> <li>negotiating and owning commercial technology contracts, including enterprise software and subscriptions, channel and reseller agreements, hardware manufacturer agreements, cloud and services</li> <li>advising on open source licensing, including permissive and copyleft licences, and familiarity with how open source communities operate.</li> </ul> </li> <li>Experience of, or demonstrable readiness for, public company governance: listing preparation, board and committee support, disclosure and controls.</li> <li>Depth in at least two of: data protection and privacy, IP and trademark, export controls and trade, competition, or disputes.</li> <li>Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, hold colleagues accountable, and share ideas without hesitation.</li> <li>Professional written and spoken English with excellent drafting and presentation skills.</li> <li>Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability.</li> <li>International travel two to four times a year for company events up to two weeks long.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Nice-to-have skills</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience taking a company through an IPO, or practicing as counsel inside a listed company.</li> <li>A technical or engineering background, or fluency in how software is built and shipped.</li> <li>Experience of a subscription or recurring-revenue business model.</li> <li>Experience building or restructuring an in-house legal function.</li> <li>A qualification in more than one jurisdiction.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we offer colleagues</strong></h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person.</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year.</li> <li>Bi-annual compensation review.</li> <li>Company recognition rewards.</li> <li>40 days annual leave per annum, including public holidays and our All Company holiday periods.</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave.</li> <li>Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform.</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues, with Priority Pass for lounge access.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>About Canonical</strong></h3> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. We are founder-led, profitable, and growing.</p> <p>Powered by worldwide distributed collaboration since our inception in 2004, we believe tech and business leadership can emerge anywhere. We have no central headquarters. Most of us work from home, but we are exceptionally disciplined about this. We have very high expectations of all colleagues, and are champions of excellence. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <p><strong>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</strong></p> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products.<a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity"> Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p>

You’ll apply judgement in areas of organisational or technical complexity, steward initiatives end-to-end, and focus your hands-on contribution where it can create the greatest impact. You’ll be a trusted technical partner to senior leaders, raise the bar for Data Science across Monzo, and build capability in others through coaching, reusable approaches and clear standards.</p> <h4><strong>Our Data Science team ⭐</strong></h4> <p>We are excited to be expanding and are hiring across our Data Science teams. Whether your interests lie in Borrowing, Growth, Payments, Fincrime, Wealth or Core, we are looking for versatile people who can contribute across squads and collectives. While we allocate teams after the interview process, we aim to match your skills and aspirations with the most suitable role. Throughout the process, you will meet team members from across our Data Science collectives, who will guide you through the opportunities available. Join us and be part of shaping our future!</p> <h4><strong>🔑You’ll play a key role by...</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Shape and lead the data strategy for a large domain or collective, connecting customer and commercial goals to a clear portfolio of high-impact Data Science work</li> <li>Identify, frame and lead strategically important problems where the path is ambiguous, dependencies span teams, and decisions involve meaningful customer, commercial, regulatory or operational trade-offs</li> <li>Partner with senior leaders across product, engineering, ML, design, research, risk and operations, bringing an independent technical perspective that influences strategy and turns it into measurable outcomes</li> <li>Establish measurement strategies and metric maps that clarify how customer behaviour, product changes and business outcomes connect, enabling teams to test assumptions and make better decisions faster</li> <li>Set and evolve best practices for experimentation, causal inference, forecasting, optimisation and decision science, choosing methods that are proportionate to the decision and its risks</li> <li>Remain hands-on where your expertise is most valuable: exploring complex data, designing analyses and experiments, building models or prototypes, and resolving the hardest technical questions</li> <li>Steward critical data products and initiatives end-to-end, ensuring they are robust, well-governed, clearly documented and adopted by the people who need them</li> <li>Balance pace and analytical rigour, making pragmatic trade-offs while protecting the quality, reproducibility and interpretability of your work</li> <li>Raise Data Science standards across Monzo through technical direction, proposals, reviews, reusable methods and thoughtful challenge</li> <li>Coach and mentor data scientists and analytics engineers, using live projects and wider discipline initiatives to build sustainable capability beyond your own individual output</li> </ul> <h4><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></h4> <ul> <li>You have an exceptional track record of leading complex, business-critical Data Science work from ambiguous problem framing through to measurable outcomes</li> <li>You have shaped strategy across a large product or business domain and can influence senior leaders through clear, independent judgement</li> <li>You bring deep expertise across several Data Science disciplines and can set the technical direction for work involving significant complexity, uncertainty or risk</li> <li>You repeatedly create clarity across organisational boundaries, resolve difficult dependencies and turn long-term strategy into decisive action</li> <li>You communicate complex ideas, assumptions and risks with clarity, and hold a consistently high bar for analytical quality, governance and reproducibility</li> <li>You remain a highly credible hands-on practitioner with SQL and Python, while raising standards and multiplying the impact of experienced colleagues</li> </ul> <p><strong>The interview process:</strong></p> <p>Our interview process involves:</p> <ul> <li>Recruiter Call</li> <li>Initial Call</li> <li>Technical assessment</li> <li>Final Interviews <ul> <li>Business Fit/Collaboration</li> <li>Case Study</li> <li>Technical Interview</li> </ul> </li> </ul> <p>Our average process takes around 2–3 weeks, but we will always work around your availability. You will have the chance to speak to our recruitment team at various points during your process.</p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p>For more insight into the hiring experience at Monzo, check out our blog post written by one of our Recruiters - <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/2022/03/21/data-hiring-at-monzo">Data Hiring at Monzo</a>.</p> <h4><strong>What’s in it for you:</strong></h4> <p><strong>💰 £124,400 - £165,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + Benefits</strong></p> <p>✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK or Spain</p> <p>✅ We can sponsor visas</p> <p>📍 This role can be based in our London or Barcelona offices, but we’re also open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.</p> <p>📚 Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences</p> <p>➕ And much more - see our full list of <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">benefits</a>.</p> <p>If you prefer to work part-time, we’ll make this happen whenever we can — whether this is to help you meet other commitments or strike a great work-life balance.</p> <p>#LI-Remote</p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

title: Security Engineer, Detection and Response
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE Millions of people rely on Notion to do their most important work, and protecting that trust is foundational to everything we build. We’re looking for a hands-on Detection Engineer to build and operate the systems and workflows we use to detect and respond to attacks across Notion’s cloud-native environment. You’ll ship high-signal detections, improve the platform that powers them, participate in incident response, and help shape how detection and response engineering scales at Notion. You’ll work closely with Engineering, Corporate Security, and Infrastructure, with broad latitude to identify gaps, prioritize investments, and build what’s needed next. We view detection and response as a software engineering discipline: detections are code, platforms are products, and measurement matters WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE - Build and tune high-signal detections across cloud, identity, endpoint, and SaaS environments, with review and mentorship from senior teammates as you ramp up. - Contribute to the detection platform, including rule lifecycle management, tuning, measurement, and rollout safety. - Build tooling and automation that speed up triage, enrichment, investigation, and detection authoring, including LLM-based workflows where useful. - Turn threat intelligence and adversary TTPs into detections, telemetry requirements, and response improvements. - Take part in investigations, incident response, and postmortems, and help turn what we learn into lasting fixes. - Help define and track metrics such as coverage, MTTD, and alert quality. - Join a shared on-call rotation for incident response. SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING - We're hiring across a range of experience levels. If you have some of these skills but not all, we'd still like to hear from you. - 3+ years of experience in detection engineering, security operations, incident response, threat hunting, or a closely related security or software engineering role. - Have written or tuned detections that run in production, and care about signal quality and cutting noise. - Working knowledge of at least one detection or query language (Sigma, KQL, SPL, YARA-L, EQL, or Panther), or strong SQL or Python skills and the drive to learn one quickly. - An understanding of how attackers operate (for example, MITRE ATT&CK), and the ability to use it to decide what to detect. - Hands-on experience with AWS, GCP, or Azure, ideally including identity and access logs. - Have used SIEM, EDR, or SOAR tools in any size of environment. - Write clearly in runbooks, design docs, and incident notes, and can own well-scoped projects end to end. NICE TO HAVE - Have led purple team, blue team, or adversary emulation exercises that improved detections or telemetry. - Experience running SIEM, EDR, or SOAR platforms at large scale. - Experience building or maintaining detection-as-code workflows (version control, CI, and tests for detections). - Experience applying LLMs or agent-style tooling to security workflows. - Experience securing AI-enabled systems or endpoint tooling. - Kubernetes or container detection experience. - Background in threat intelligence, malware analysis, or digital forensics. - Contributions to the security community through research, tooling, CTFs, or talks. - Experience at a high-growth startup or AI company. Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $185,000 - $280,000 per year. By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550 and and NYLL 144 https://notion.notion.site/Ashby-AI-Bias-Audit-2b0efdeead05803bbbfae159ec86c528. #LI-Onsite A NOTE ON AI You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on. EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know. Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE Millions of people rely on Notion to do their most important work, and protecting that trust is foundational to everything we build. We’re looking for a hands-on Detection Engineer to build and operate the systems and workflows we use to detect and respond to attacks across Notion’s cloud-native environment. You’ll ship high-signal detections, improve the platform that powers them, participate in incident response, and help shape how detection and response engineering scales at Notion. You’ll work closely with Engineering, Corporate Security, and Infrastructure, with broad latitude to identify gaps, prioritize investments, and build what’s needed next. We view detection and response as a software engineering discipline: detections are code, platforms are products, and measurement matters WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE - Build and tune high-signal detections across cloud, identity, endpoint, and SaaS environments, with review and mentorship from senior teammates as you ramp up. - Contribute to the detection platform, including rule lifecycle management, tuning, measurement, and rollout safety. - Build tooling and automation that speed up triage, enrichment, investigation, and detection authoring, including LLM-based workflows where useful. - Turn threat intelligence and adversary TTPs into detections, telemetry requirements, and response improvements. - Take part in investigations, incident response, and postmortems, and help turn what we learn into lasting fixes. - Help define and track metrics such as coverage, MTTD, and alert quality. - Join a shared on-call rotation for incident response. SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING - We're hiring across a range of experience levels. If you have some of these skills but not all, we'd still like to hear from you. - 3+ years of experience in detection engineering, security operations, incident response, threat hunting, or a closely related security or software engineering role. - Have written or tuned detections that run in production, and care about signal quality and cutting noise. - Working knowledge of at least one detection or query language (Sigma, KQL, SPL, YARA-L, EQL, or Panther), or strong SQL or Python skills and the drive to learn one quickly. - An understanding of how attackers operate (for example, MITRE ATT&CK), and the ability to use it to decide what to detect. - Hands-on experience with AWS, GCP, or Azure, ideally including identity and access logs. - Have used SIEM, EDR, or SOAR tools in any size of environment. - Write clearly in runbooks, design docs, and incident notes, and can own well-scoped projects end to end. NICE TO HAVE - Have led purple team, blue team, or adversary emulation exercises that improved detections or telemetry. - Experience running SIEM, EDR, or SOAR platforms at large scale. - Experience building or maintaining detection-as-code workflows (version control, CI, and tests for detections). - Experience applying LLMs or agent-style tooling to security workflows. - Experience securing AI-enabled systems or endpoint tooling. - Kubernetes or container detection experience. - Background in threat intelligence, malware analysis, or digital forensics. - Contributions to the security community through research, tooling, CTFs, or talks. - Experience at a high-growth startup or AI company. title: Credit Risk Oversight Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍London/Cardiff/UK Remote | 💰£79,900 - £95,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Benefits</a>  ✨</p> <p><strong>Our Credit Oversight team⭐</strong></p> <p>Our Borrowing (lending) business is growing rapidly across both existing products and with the planned launch of new initiatives. As our lending portfolio grows, our second line of defence Credit Risk Oversight team is growing with it - and we’re looking for a Credit Risk Oversight Manager to join us!</p> <p>Our Credit Risk Oversight team is crucial in providing support and challenge to our Borrowing teams in the first line of defence to help Monzo grow safely. We’re looking for someone (maybe you?!) with proven experience in consumer credit risk who likes getting into the details and analysing data to deliver independent assurance - and challenge - of credit risk management across the lifecycle. </p> <p>Ideally you’ll have experience and in-depth knowledge of retail unsecured or small business credit risk strategy within financial services. You’ll have seen first-hand how a credit portfolio performs at different stages of the credit cycle, and have hands-on experience in shaping or overseeing lending strategies. You’ll have a collaborative approach, and be comfortable working across a broad range of stakeholders. You’ll also be someone who likes getting into the details, analysing data and providing constructive challenges.</p> <p><strong>🔑You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <p><strong>Providing ongoing oversight of credit risk - this includes analysing and understanding the performance of our existing lending products, developing and enhancing monitoring metrics and providing input to relevant committees and forums  </strong></p> <ul> <li>Partnering with our first line of defence teams to support credit strategy changes - including new product launches and pilots - ensuring that we deliver magical lending products for our customers while meeting our Risk Appetite</li> <li>Delivering deep insight, feedback and challenge on our credit strategies - including data-driven analysis and actionable counter-proposals - to support management decision making and shaping better outcomes for our customers</li> <li>Leading second line assurance work on thematic reviews</li> <li>Collaborating with our model validation and model development teams to ensure understanding of the models that underpin our credit strategies</li> <li>Providing credit expertise and input into relevant strategic projects and critical Monzo-wide processes, such as stress-testing and forecasting</li> <li>Supporting us in maintaining our Credit Risk Framework and making sure it is well embedded within the business</li> <li>Taking a balanced and proportionate approach to risk management, making sure that managing risks becomes part of everyone at Monzo’s day-to-day role</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if you …</strong></p> <ul> <li>Have a strong background in credit risk management within consumer or small business lending - experience in unsecured product, such as credit cards, loans or overdrafts would be particularly beneficial</li> <li>Have proven analytical skills, and can use these to interrogate data, build monitoring and look for early indicators of trends</li> <li>Have hands-on experience and/or understanding of how to use credit risk scorecards and NPV models to develop strategies for making credit decisions</li> <li>Have a solid technical toolkit; SQL or similar is a must-have, and experience using a data visualisation tool (such as Looker, PowerBI or Tableau) is a plus</li> <li>Are excited to explore how we can use AI tools to improve our credit and risk management processes</li> <li>Can convey problems and solutions using clear and simple language, both written and verbal (see <a href="https://monzo.com/tone-of-voice/">Monzo’s tone of voice</a> guide). This is particularly important for communicating complex issues and priorities to non-experts</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Have a track record of building and maintaining trusting relationships with stakeholders, while providing effective and respectful challenge</li> <li>Are passionate about technology, and what we’re doing here at Monzo excites you!</li> </ul> <p>Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply - even if you don’t have everything that's listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!</p> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 £79,900-95,000 ➕Incentive Awards tied to your performance.</p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London) </p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. </p> <p>➕ Plus lots more! <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Read our full list of benefits</a>.</p> <p><strong>🌈 The application journey has 4 key steps</strong></p> <ul> <li>An initial call with our recruiter</li> <li>A call with one of our Credit Risk Oversight Managers, the hiring manager(s) for the role </li> <li>A take-home task</li> <li>Two competency, based interviews - one role specific technical interview and one behaviours and values interview</li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 4-8 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p>#LI-TK1<strong><br><br></strong></p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

title: Director Payment Integrity
description: Job Title: Director, Payment Integrity Reports To: Vice President, Operations This is an exempt position reporting to the Vice President, Operations. The Director of Payment Integrity is responsible for the Quality Assurance, Grievances & Appeals, and Fraud, Waste & Abuse teams. This role functions as both the director setting strategy for these departments and the direct supervisor managing day to day operations. This position interfaces with all departments of SIHO as well as external stakeholders, vendors, and customers. The ability to interact with all levels of SIHO staff and external parties with a high level of professionalism, while adapting quickly between multiple high priority items, is essential. Brief Description of Duties: Directly supervise and manage the Quality Assurance, Grievances & Appeals, and Fraud, Waste & Abuse teams, including day to day oversight, staffing, and performance management Read, research, and interpret federal and state regulations governing grievances and appeals, and translate regulatory requirements into practical, actionable process changes Continuously monitor and improve grievances and appeals processes to ensure ongoing compliance with CMS and state regulatory requirements Support the claims and benefit configuration quality assurance program, including developing and delivering training and education for staff Stay current on emerging fraud, waste, and abuse trends and lead efforts to proactively identify and investigate potential FWA Review results across all three departments and identify process improvement initiatives and cost savings opportunities Analyze department and operational data in Excel to identify trends and draw actionable insights Manage data transfers with vendor partners, meet with vendors regularly to ensure processes are working as intended, and escalate potential issues as they arise Interact directly with customers as needed Work with SIHO Legal and key leadership on special cases and external inquiries from CMS, the Indiana Department of Insurance, law enforcement, and others Develop, maintain, and report statistical measurements assessing the effectiveness of the QA, FWA, and G&A programs Lead or support key corporate and departmental compliance initiatives, including SOC audits, CMS Part C Reporting and ODAG, and others as assigned Minimum Skills Requirement: B.S. degree or equivalent work experience in a healthcare operation 3-5 years experience in a managed care environment Strong understanding of federal and state regulations related to grievances and appeals, including CMS and state Department of Insurance requirements Experience across Medicare Advantage, ACA, employer group/TPA, and MEWA products preferred Demonstrated ability to lead and manage people and teams, while also directly supervising staff on a daily basis Proficient in Excel with the ability to analyze data and draw actionable insights Thorough understanding of medical and health plan terminology; familiarity with CPT, HCPCS, and ICD-10 coding a plus Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly communicate with all levels of management as well as external entities, vendors, and customers Ability to work successfully at a self-directed pace in a changing, fast-paced, high demand environment, adapting quickly between competing high priority items Ability to work successfully under tight deadlines Experience with SIHO systems including the HSP claims system Proficient in Microsoft Office suite products including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook All positions are subject to change based on the needs of the business. \n \n Please mention the word **GRACIOUSNESS** and tag RMjAuMTA2LjE5MS40OQ== when applying to show you read the job post completely (#RMjAuMTA2LjE5MS40OQ==). description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. Working directly alongside our Lead Solutions Architect, Model Builders, and the FP&A team, you will act as the key engine powering daily operations—managing change requests, facilitating user training, and getting hands-on with model building activities to enhance our financial planning ecosystem.</p> <h3><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by…</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Implementing Change Requests:</strong> Managing, triaging, and delivering end-to-end Change Requests across our Anaplan models to ensure seamless business operations.</li> <li><strong>Supporting Model Building:</strong> Collaborating closely with Lead Solutions Architect and Model Builders to assist in building, testing, and implementing new functionalities and enhancements.</li> <li><strong>Providing Training & Supporting End Users:</strong> Designing and delivering engaging training sessions and documentation to upskill end-users across FP&A and Finance Business Partner teams.</li> <li><strong>Maintaining & Optimising Models:</strong> Maintaining data integrity, managing user access, monitoring model performance, and troubleshooting issues as they arise.</li> </ul> 2 Model Builder certification or equivalent is highly desirable).</li> <li><strong>Managed Change Requests & Supported Systems:</strong> Proven track record handling Change Requests, user support tickets, and system enhancements in a CoE or support structure.</li> <li><strong>Model Building Skills:</strong> Functional understanding of Anaplan model architecture and formula building, with the ability to assist in active model development.</li> <li><strong>Experience Training Users:</strong> Strong communication and facilitation skills, with a passion for training and empowering non-technical users on Anaplan functionality.</li> <li><strong>An Understanding of Finance:</strong> Solid foundational understanding of financial modelling, FP&A principles, or finance workflows.</li> <li><strong>AI Tooling</strong>: Familiarity with AI tools, including the ability to write effective prompts. actual cables to connect to various third parties</li> </ul> <p><strong>The Interview Process:</strong></p> <p>Our interview process involves three main stages: </p> <ol> <li>Initial Call </li> href="https://monzo.com/blog/2022/03/23/demystifying-the-backend-engineering-interview-process"><strong>here</strong></a>.</p> <p><strong>What’s in it for you:</strong></p> <p>💰 <span style="font-weight: 400;">£85,000 - £110,000</span> base salary <span style="font-weight: 400;">+<strong> </strong>Incentive Awards tied to your performance</span></p> <p>✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK </p> <p>✅ We can sponsor visas.</p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).</p> <p>⏰We offer conferences</p> <p>➕And much more, see our full list of benefits <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"><strong>here </strong></a></p> <p><em>We're usually always hiring for Backend Engineers, so title: Director of Product Design
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. Product Design is the largest discipline within the design organisation, with designers working in tight-knit squads alongside researchers, product managers, and engineers to solve real customer problems at scale.</p> <p>We design for the “magic moments.” We’ve built a bank that feels deeply human, not just functional, shaping how millions of people experience money every day. Our product is our personality. We combine research, empathy, and craft to turn everyday interactions into memorable experiences.</p> <p>Now, we’re entering our next phase of growth and looking for exceptional design leaders to help define not only Monzo’s future, but the future of banking itself. investing in their growth, wellbeing, and long-term success.</li> <li>Maintaining an exceptional quality bar across all design work through clear feedback and coaching, helping designers and teams consistently deliver best-in-class experiences.</li> <li>Creating an environment where feedback is open, craft is celebrated, and design quality continues to evolve across the organisation.</li> <li>Acting as a champion for design at Monzo, influencing how design thinking shapes our products and culture.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h2>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if...</h2> <ul> <li>You’ve led design strategy and vision across complex product areas, helping teams navigate ambiguity and deliver meaningful customer and business impact.</li> <li>You’re comfortable operating at multiple altitudes, from defining long-term direction to driving high-quality execution.</li> <li>You build strong partnerships across Product, Engineering, Research and Commercial, and know how to influence senior stakeholders through clarity, insight, and craft.</li> <li>You have a strong point of view on product design and consistently raise the bar for quality, systems thinking, and customer experience.</li> <li>You’ve built and led high-performing design teams, creating environments where people can grow, do exceptional work, and have meaningful impact.</li> <li>You know how to scale design influence across an organisation, shaping product direction, ways of working, and culture beyond your immediate team.</li> <li>You’re energised by Monzo’s mission to make money work for everyone, and excited to help shape the next generation of payments experiences through thoughtful, magical and innovative design. </li> </ul> <p> </p> <h2>🙌 What’s in it for you</h2> <ul> <li>💰 £140,000 - Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out. </p> <p> </p> <p>#LI-TR1</p> <p>#LI-Remote</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. Teams are organised into groups, and then collectives - we aim to keep our line management structure as shallow as possible, and for teams to directly own decision making relevant to their work.</p> <p>The Engineering Manager role at Monzo is split into three pillars - people, product, and technical leadership. We hire on a pipeline based approach which means your application will be considered across all of our open EM positions. We use the interview process to assess your strengths and we'll match you to a role that best aligns with your experience. Of course, this is a collaborative process so you can also tell us which roles you're most interested in as you progress through interviews 😊 We're currently hiring across Platform, Core App, and Expansion.</p> <p><strong>You’ll spend your time:</strong></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Taking accountability for delivery across your squad(s), collaborating with the Technical Lead and Product Manager.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;">Actively fostering a high bar for engineering excellence within your teams. You’re accountable for the technical outcomes your teams deliver alongside individual engineer performance and growth, so holding a high bar (and clearly articulating your expectations) is key.</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">You’ll initially lead a group of around 7-10 engineers (depending on the role) and support, coach and develop them through their career with regular 1:1s and continuous feedback.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Partner with senior engineers in your area to drive technical initiatives that raise the bar for our engineering practices.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Lead on communication with stakeholders from other teams, creating focus space for engineers to do their best work.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Collaborate with the wider engineering organisation to contribute to company-wide best managerial and technical practices and standards.</span></li> </ul> <p><strong>You should apply if:</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">While this is not a role which requires hands-on-coding, we are looking for an experienced manager who has a strong technical and delivery background and </span><strong>has worked as a software engineer in previous roles.</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We recognise that engineering managers lead in different ways, we’re looking for someone who: </span></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Is comfortable operating with ambiguous problem areas with a high degree of autonomy.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">It’s a bonus if you have experience working in an experimentation led environment.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Has delivery experience and is able to guide the squads in achieving their outcomes.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Focuses on outcomes over processes, who optimises for the highest impact and leverage.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Is able to input, understand and challenge engineering decisions - but to empower the team to make those decisions themselves</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Has an understanding of what good looks like for a high-performing team of engineers and ability to chart a course to get there</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Is able to to coach people to achieve their goals</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Has a natural ability to inspire and motivate a team</span></li> </ul> <p><em><span style="font-weight: 400;">We consider your application across all open EM roles at Monzo independent of which role you've applied for, so </span></em><strong><em>if you've recently applied to a similar role at Monzo and have been unsuccessful, please wait 6 months before applying again.<br><br></em></strong></p> <p><strong>How we work 💻:</strong></p> <p><strong>Locations & Flexible Working : </strong></p> <p>Our main tech hub is in London, but our engineers live everywhere in the UK— from Brighton to the Western Isles. </p> <p>We value meeting in person but there’s no pressure to come into the office, even if you're nearby. If you live outside of London and we ask you to come into the office, Monzo will support you with the costs. ✨</p> <p>Our offices are naturally social, especially Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays, which happen to line up with our twice-weekly Monzo lunches & treat Thursdays 🍽️. You'll make it effortless for them to find the right products at the exact moment they need them.</p> <p>Whether it’s surfacing the right savings product at the perfect moment, helping customers manage their spending, or simplifying financial planning, our work makes banking smarter, more intuitive, and truly customer-first.</p> <h2><strong><span class="notion-enable-hover" data-token-index="0">What you’ll be working on:</span></strong></h2> <div class="notion-selectable notion-text-block" data-block-id="39569fe4-26d2-80f7-b7b1-c3e03c9b7fe8"> <div class="x78zum5"> <div id=":rl36:" class="content-editable-leaf-rtl notranslate" data-content-editable-leaf="true">As a Lead Machine Learning Scientist, you'll be a technical leader and individual contributor. We have a modern, cloud-native data platform with billions of rows of data built for fast iterations. You'll leverage your deep expertise to develop and deploy advanced ML models to our more than 15 million customers.</div> <div> </div> </div> </div> <div class="notion-selectable notion-text-block" data-block-id="39569fe4-26d2-80b8-8740-c2c314894362"> <div> <div> <div> <div class="x78zum5"> <div id=":rl37:" class="content-editable-leaf-rtl notranslate" data-content-editable-leaf="true"><span class="discussion-level-1 discussion-id-39569fe4-26d2-80d3-845e-001cd33a75ba notion-enable-hover" data-token-index="0">Your work may involve user and product embeddings to better understand customer behaviours, contextual bandits for optimising real-time decisions, or personalised ranking algorithms that improve search and discovery. You'll also build scalable, explainable, and responsible AI solutions that enhance trust, transparency, and the overall customer experience.</span></div> <div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> <div class="notion-selectable notion-text-block" data-block-id="39569fe4-26d2-803a-b699-d14b2512f916"> <div> <div> <div> <div class="x78zum5"> <div id=":rl38:" class="content-editable-leaf-rtl notranslate" data-content-editable-leaf="true"><span class="discussion-level-1 discussion-id-39569fe4-26d2-80d3-845e-001cd33a75ba notion-enable-hover" data-token-index="0">The technical approaches you take to help solve customer problems will be very much in your hands and we’ll strongly encourage and support experimentation and innovation. We’ll be expecting you to justify and demonstrate effectiveness along the way, making sure the approach meets our business and customer needs.</span></div> <div class="content-editable-leaf-rtl notranslate" data-content-editable-leaf="true"> </div> <div class="content-editable-leaf-rtl notranslate" data-content-editable-leaf="true"> <h2><strong>You should apply if:</strong></h2> <p>What we’re doing here at Monzo excites you!</p> <ul> <li>You have a multiple year track record of excellence leading the development and deployment of advanced Machine Learning models to tackle real business problems preferably in a fast moving tech company</li> <li>You have experience developing and shipping state of the art ML models to production and delivering business impact</li> <li>You're <em>impact driven</em> and excited to own the end to end journey that starts with a business problem and ends with your solution having a measurable impact in production</li> <li>You have a <em>self-starter mindset;</em> you proactively identify issues and opportunities and tackle them without being told to do so</li> <li>You speak Python fluently and have extensive, hands-on experience with <code>scikit-learn</code>. You are comfortable using SQL, and keen to learn <a href="https://go.dev/">Go lang</a> which is used in many of our backend microservices</li> <li>You’re comfortable working in a team that deals with ambiguity and have experience helping your team and stakeholders resolve that ambiguity</li> <li>You want to be involved in building a product that you (and the people you know) use every day</li> <li>You have a <em>product mindset</em>: you care about customer outcomes and you want to make data-informed decisions</li> <li>You're excited about fast-moving developments in Machine Learning and can communicate those ideas to colleagues who are not familiar with the domain</li> <li>You’re adaptable, curious and enjoy learning new technologies and ideas</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Nice to haves:</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience working on personalisation, ranking & recommendation problems for consumer applications</li> <li>Commercial experience writing critical production code and working with microservices</li> </ul> <h2><strong>The interview process:</strong></h2> <p>Our interview process involves 3 main stages. We promise not to ask you any brain teasers or trick questions!</p> <p>30 minute recruiter call</p> <p>45 minute call with hiring manager</p> <p>Full Loop: ML Modelling Interview, Product & ML interview, Behavioural Interview, Leadership interview</p> <p>Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability.</p> <h1>What’s in it for you: </h1> <p>✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK</p> <p>✅ We can sponsor visas</p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.</p> <p>📚Learning budget of £1,000 a year for training courses and conferences</p> <p>➕And much more, see our full list of benefits <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">here</a></p> <p>If you prefer to work part-time, we'll make this happen whenever we can - whether this is to help you meet other commitments or strike a great work-life balance</p> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> <p>#LI-REMOTE #LI-SR1</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. title: Lead Product Designer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone. Product Design makes up almost half of our design disciplines, working in tight-knit squads alongside research, product, and engineering to solve real customer problems at scale.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>We design for the "magic moments"</strong></p> <p>We’ve built a bank that feels human, not just functional. Our product <em>is</em> our personality. We blend research, empathy, and craft to turn everyday interactions into memorable experiences.</p> <p>Right now, we’re growing fast and looking for passionate designers to shape Monzo’s future and there’s a huge opportunity to make your mark.</p> <p>Applying to this role, you’ll be in a standard hiring process for a Lead Product Designer, and we’ll find the perfect team for you along the way. </p> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p><strong>🔑You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <ul> <li>Tackling the most complex and ambiguous design challenges, turning complexity into elegant, scalable solutions that empower teams and improve the customer experience.</li> <li>Defining and delivering large-scale projects that connect initiatives across the business, using design methods to align strategies and drive impactful outcomes.</li> <li>Leading the creation of compelling product visions, principles, and direction that inspire teams to build toward a shared future.</li> <li>Using AI to level-up parts of your design workflow. Whether that’s ideation, analysis, prototyping or shipping production code to our app.</li> <li>Raising the bar for visual execution, considering motion, interaction, and mental model clarity to deliver delightful and practical solutions.</li> <li>Positively influencing our design system, tooling, and processes to improve how we create design at scale.</li> <li>Driving improvements across the business by connecting your work to wider goals and leveraging cross-functional collaboration.</li> <li>Acting as a role model in Design, sharing your work broadly, mentoring others, and contributing to the growth and success of the Design team.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have a proven track record of delivering impactful, customer-centric native-app designs that solve complex problems and drive commercial outcomes.</li> <li>You’re skilled at leading research, defining product visions, and aligning teams around a shared strategy.</li> <li>You excel at creating modular, scalable solutions and have a strong grasp of how to use design artefacts to communicate insights effectively.</li> <li>You’re a natural collaborator who can navigate multi-squad projects, align leadership, and drive clarity in ambiguous situations.</li> <li>You’re passionate about improving design systems, processes, and ways of working to help teams deliver better outcomes at scale.</li> <li>You’re a role model who actively contributes to the growth of the Design team through hiring, mentoring, and fostering a positive culture.</li> <li>You’re excited about Monzo’s mission to make money work for everyone and are ready to make a significant impact on our customers and business.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>🙌What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 £90,000 - £120,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance</p> <p>✈️ We’ll help you relocate to the UK.</p> <p>✅ We can sponsor your visa.</p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).</p> <p>⏰We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team.</p> <p>📚£1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup.</p> <p>➕ Plus lots more!</p> <p> </p> <p>🌈<strong> The application journey has 3 key steps</strong></p> <ul> <li>30-minute call with our Recruiter</li> <li>1-hour craft interview where you’ll present a single case study to 2 members of our Design team</li> <li>2 x 45-minute interviews covering Teamwork and Impact</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p>This process should take around 4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. title: Senior Backend Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍London or UK Remote | 💰<a href="https://monzo.com/documents/engineering-progression-framework-v4-0.pdf"> Senior Engineer (L50)</a> £105,000 - £135,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Benefits</a> | <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/technology">Technology</a> - Engineering  </p> <p><strong>About our Engineering Teams:</strong></p> <p>We have around 650 engineers across Monzo who design and build our in-house banking platform. We have big ambitions for the future, and technology plays a big role in creating a bank our customers want, so engineers at Monzo collaborate across disciplines to solve interesting challenges throughout the company.</p> <p>These range from the products our customers use everyday to underlying infrastructure, security, payments and finance, customer operations, financial crime, and data, to name just a few areas. As a bank, there is scope for impact across a huge number of opportunities.</p> <p>We contribute to <a href="https://github.com/monzo"><strong>open source software</strong></a> as much as possible. Our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/technology"><strong>blog</strong></a><strong> </strong>is a good place to learn even more about what we do!</p> <p><strong>Your day-to-day   </strong></p> <p>This role is all about collaborating with your team to make a difference to your customers. As a backend engineer you’ll work in a squad alongside other disciplines like product managers, marketers, user researchers, designers, mobile engineers, web engineers, data analysts, business analysts, writers and more! </p> <p>Together you'll build and support a particular part of Monzo. Our squads belong to our wider collectives (a word we use to describe self-governing business units of ~100 people). They are: Core Banking, Business Banking, Wealth, Borrowing, Growth, Payments, Platform, Fincrime, Security & Expansion. All of our collectives are doing innovative work, many of which have machine learning and AI at the forefront- from fighting financial crime to building smarter financial tools - and you may have the opportunity to join a collective that gives you direct exposure to this exciting space.</p> <p>They’re all looking for additional Backend Engineers right now, we do a standard interview process across all our collectives and at the end we will find the best match for you based on your skills, experience, preferences and aligning with the business need! </p> <p>Our backend engineers have a variety of different backgrounds. As long as you enjoy learning new things, we’d love to talk to you. We do not ask for formal qualifications or degree requirements for any of our engineering roles.</p> <p><strong>How we work 💻</strong></p> <p>Our main tech hub is in London, but our engineers live everywhere in the UK— from Brighton to the Western Isles. We value meeting in person but we don't have a mandated requirement on office attendance, even if you're nearby. We believe you'll do your best work if you are where you want to be. If you live outside of London and we ask you to come into the office, Monzo will support you with the costs ✨</p> <p>Our offices are naturally social, especially Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays, which happen to line up with our twice-weekly Monzo lunches & treat Thursdays 🍽️</p> <p>Teams also schedule time together often for work and play – in or around the office, or online.</p> <p><strong>Set up a work schedule that delivers impact and fits your life:</strong></p> <p>At Monzo, we value connections, flexibility, and wellbeing. We keep our meetings during core hours to stay connected and believe in maintaining work/life balance.</p> <p>You’ll be empowered to manage your work in a way that suits you and your team, giving you the freedom for children drop-offs and pick-ups, walking your dog or adventurous cat, avoiding peak commuting times or gym slots, appointments, or supporting your family in an emergency 🕣✨</p> <p>If you prefer to work part-time, we'll make this happen whenever we can - whether this is to help you meet other commitments or strike a great work-life balance.</p> <p><strong>Work the way that works for you with Monzo! 💼</strong></p> <p><strong>You should apply if:</strong></p> <ul> <li>you have strong experience working on the backend of a technology product</li> <li>you want to be involved in building a product that you (and the people you know) use every day</li> <li>you have a product mindset: you care about customer outcomes and you want to make data-informed decisions</li> <li>you’re comfortable working in a team that deals with ambiguity</li> <li>you’re interested in distributed systems and writing resilient software</li> <li>you have some experience with strongly-typed languages (Go, Java, C, Scala etc.).</li> <li>you think you’d enjoy the kind of work we’re doing</li> </ul> <p>We're on the look out for L50 Engineers at the moment, you can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/documents/engineering-progression-framework-v4-1.pdf">Engineering Progression Framework </a>- we will interview you across the whole frame work, so if you are not sure what level you are aiming for please chat to your recruiters! </p> <p><em>Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply— even if you don’t have everything thats listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!</em></p> <p><strong>What you’ll be working on: </strong></p> <p>We hire very technically agnostic so whilst we use the below technologies we do not expect prior knowledge, you will be fully supported in our organised onboarding to get up to speed in the below: </p> <ul> <li><a href="http://golang.org/"><strong>Go</strong></a> to write our description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK.
